Body Position Place Speed °/day Altitude Elongation from Sun Sun 20°20' Libra 8th 0.99 +12.7° - Moon 7°31' Leo 6th 12.79 (slow) -20.5° -72.8° (waning) Mercury 2°47' Scorpio 9th 1.56 +16.9° +12.5° (evening) Venus 16°08' Libra 8th 1.25 +12.2° -4.2° (morning) Mars 3°53' Virgo 7th 0.61 -6.1° -46.4° (morning) Jupiter 19°42' Pisces 1st -0.10 R -1.0° +149.4° Saturn 0°57' Taurus 3rd -0.08 R -19.3° -169.4° Ascendant (hōroskopos) 20°39' Pisces 1st Midheaven 25°00' Sagittarius 10th sign Mean / true node 28°35' Leo / 0°09' Virgo 6th / 7th What this means for you Interpretation : The ancient reader's first glance falls on the hour-marker and what is on it. Your Ascendant is Pisces, and Jupiter, its own lord, sits within a degree of it. Valens (I.1) calls Jupiter the giver of children, friendships, gifts, honours and trust Source, verify . Dorotheus (I) calls a benefic on the hour-marker a mark of a well-supported life. In plain terms, the chart's first statement is about you as a person: decent, liked, trusted, and generous with your own resources. Most of the remaining weight sits in hidden or cadent places (6th, 8th, 9th, 3rd). This is a nativity whose force is personal and private, not public. The Midheaven, the place of reputation and action, is empty. Synthesis: a strong, self-ruled Ascendant, a public sector with nothing in it, and a lot of activity in the "hidden" places.

Sect: altitude of each planet at birth Calculated The Sun is 12.7° above the horizon, so this is a day nativity . The sect light is the Sun. The benefic of sect is Jupiter, the malefic of sect is Saturn, and the contrary malefic is Mars. Mercury is an evening star here, which puts it with the nocturnal sect (Ptolemy I.7; Valens III.5 Source, verify ). Hayz-type conditions: the Sun is above the earth in a masculine sign (in condition). Jupiter is below the horizon by 1° of altitude (the body sits on the hour-marker but has −1.5° latitude) and in a feminine sign, so not in full condition. Saturn is below the earth in a feminine sign. Mars is a nocturnal planet below the earth by day, in a feminine sign, so half in condition. What this means for you Interpretation : Sect tells you which planets "work for you" and which work against you (Valens II.1 Source, verify ). You are a day person in this sense. Jupiter, the planet on your Ascendant, is on your side, so its good is reliable rather than fitful. Saturn is the malefic of your own sect, which in this doctrine means its hardships are constructive: slow, dutiful, workable. Mars is the out-of-sect malefic, and it sits in your 7th place of partners and open opponents. So the planet least restrained in this chart is the one that governs other people facing you: partners, rivals, contracts. In character: steadier inner disposition (Jupiter); friction tends to come from outside, through other people. Synthesis: the "helpful" planets (Sun, Jupiter, Saturn) belong to your sect. The planet out of sect, Mars, governs your relationships and your adversaries.

docs.h: 2. Dignities: domicile, exaltation, triplicity, bounds, faces
docs.t: Essential dignity table Egyptian vs Ptolemaic bounds, occupied signs Calculated Jupiter is in its domicile (Pisces) and its own face: 19°42′ falls in the second decan of Pisces (10°–20°), whose Chaldean face lord is Jupiter. (Round 3 correction: earlier text said "third decan"; the Ascendant at 20°39′ is in the third decan, Mars's face.) Venus is in its domicile (Libra). Mars holds triplicity by night only: Dorotheus's earth rulers are Venus by day and the Moon by night, with Mars as participating ruler, so Mars here is a participating triplicity ruler. The Sun is in its fall (Libra, Saturn's exaltation). The Moon, Mercury and Saturn are peregrine by sign. Bounds (Egyptian / Ptolemaic Source, verify for Ptolemaic ): - Sun: Jupiter / Mercury - Moon: Venus / Mercury - Mercury: Mars / Mars - Venus: Jupiter / Jupiter - Mars: Mercury / Mercury - Jupiter: Mars / Mercury - Saturn: Venus / Venus - Ascendant: Mars / Mars - MC: Saturn / Mars Mutual reception: Venus rules Taurus, where Saturn is, and Saturn is exalted in Libra, where Venus is. So Venus and Saturn are in mutual reception by domicile and exaltation. Mercury's sign lord, Mars, sits in Mercury's own sign Virgo. That is a domicile exchange between Mercury and Mars. What this means for you Interpretation : Two planets are "at home": Jupiter, which is you (the Ascendant lord), and Venus, which rules relationships, pleasures and your 3rd and 8th places. The Sun, the light of your sect and the significator of reputation, rank and the father (Valens I.1 Source, verify ), is in its fall. Firmicus treats a fallen Sun as dimming rank and public honour (II.? Source, verify ). The ancient reading is that recognition and official standing don't come easily; you build them through others. The Mercury–Mars exchange ties how you think and speak (Mercury) to your partners and opponents (Mars in the 7th). You argue, negotiate and solve problems in a sharp, practical, technical way. The Venus–Saturn reception means your affections and your duties hold each other up: loyalty in love, and seriousness about money that is shared or inherited (8th). Synthesis: you are self-governing (Jupiter at home on the Ascendant) and you have resources through Venus. By bare dignity the Sun looks like the weak point. Read placement-first (§3a), it is strong-in-shadow.

Calculated The places are counted from Pisces. - 1st Pisces: Jupiter - 2nd Aries: empty - 3rd Taurus: Saturn - 4th Gemini: Lot of Spirit - 5th Cancer: Lots of Courage and Nemesis - 6th Leo: Moon, Lots of Eros and Basis - 7th Virgo: Mars - 8th Libra: Sun, Venus - 9th Scorpio: Mercury - 10th Sagittarius: Midheaven degree - 11th Capricorn: Lots of Fortune, Victory, Mother and Action - 12th Aquarius: Lot of Siblings Places averse to the Ascendant (no sign-aspect to it): 2, 6, 8 and 12, so the Sun, Venus and Moon are all in aversion. Angular planets: Jupiter (1) and Mars (7). Planetary joys (Mercury 1st, Moon 3rd, Venus 5th, Mars 6th, Sun 9th, Jupiter 11th, Saturn 12th; Paulus 24 / Firmicus II.? Source, verify ): no planet is in its joy . What this means for you Interpretation : In Valens's scheme (II) both lights, the Sun and the Moon, are in places that do not "see" the hour-marker. Ancient authors read this as luminaries that work behind the scenes. The Moon in the 6th is the place of servants, labour and subordination. The Sun in the 8th is the place of other people's money, inheritance and idleness Source, verify . For work, this points to labour done for or under others, or with other people's resources, more than to a public post. For family, the Sun (father) in the 8th and averse suggests distance or a reserved relationship with the father. Dorotheus also reads the father from the Sun and Saturn, and Saturn is in your 3rd. The 3rd is the "goddess" place and the place of siblings. Saturn there, in sect, points to responsibilities toward siblings, short journeys and local circles. Synthesis: personal place strong (1st). Partnerships active (7th). Lights hidden (6th and 8th).

Hidden strength: bare dignity versus net verdict per planet Where is what: whole-sign places from the Ascendant and from Fortune Rules tested for each planet Source, verify for Valens's wording : sect and rejoicing (hayz); place (angular, succedent, cadent; good or bad; aversion to the Ascendant); rulership and reception (domicile lord's aspect); exchange of houses; overcoming (superior square, Porphyry 21); spear-bearing; phase (under the beams, phasis within 7 days); retrogradation; places counted from the Lot of Fortune (Valens II); joys (none of the planets is in its joy). Strength is claimed only where a rule fires. Planet Bare condition Context tested Calculated Net verdict Sun 20°20′ Libra, 8th; fall sect light; above the earth in a masculine sign (rejoices); in Jupiter's bound; domicile lord Venus copresent in her own sign and spear-bearing; 10th from Fortune and overcoming Fortune by square; exaltation lord Saturn averse strong-in-shadow Moon 7°31′ Leo, 6th; peregrine out of sect; waning (last-quarter side); in a bad place averse to the Ascendant; decimated by Saturn from Taurus; received by her domicile lord the Sun (sextile); next applies to Venus weak (mitigated) Mercury 2°47′ Scorpio, 9th; peregrine domicile exchange with Mars, which sees it (sextile, 1°); emerging from the beams as an evening star within 7 days (phasis, 4.75 d); trined by Jupiter; opposed by Saturn within 2°; overcome by the Moon and Mars; 11th from Fortune reversed-strong Venus 16°08′ Libra, 8th; domicile under the beams (4.2° from the Sun); out of sect; bad place averse to the Ascendant; but in her own sign, spear-bearer of the Sun, angular (10th) from Fortune; reception with Saturn is in aversion strong-in-shadow Mars 3°53′ Virgo, 7th; triplicity partner angular (setting); out of sect; morning star 46° west of the Sun (suits Mars); domicile exchange with Mercury; opposed by Jupiter from the Ascendant; 9th from Fortune reversed-strong Jupiter 19°42′ Pisces, 1st; domicile + face benefic of sect; lord of the Ascendant on the Ascendant (0.9°); retrograde, occidental, 1° below the horizon; opposes Mars; overcomes Saturn; trines Mercury; 3rd from Fortune strong Saturn 0°57′ Taurus, 3rd; peregrine malefic of sect; retrograde; lord of Fortune and trine to it; overcome (bonified) by Jupiter's sextile; decimates the Moon; 5th from Fortune (good place) cancelled (harm cancelled; acts constructively) Sun: strong-in-shadow. What this means for you Interpretation : Your Sun is not the weak point earlier rounds called it. It works from a hidden place but it is the day's ruling light, rejoicing above the earth, guarded by Venus in her own sign and standing at the top (10th) of your Fortune chart. Your authority works best through partners, shared resources and behind-the-scenes influence rather than open display. Moon: weak (mitigated). What this means for you Interpretation : Your daily life and body-routine carry real load: work, obligation, being of use, under Saturn's pressure. The Sun's reception and the Moon's next contact with Venus soften it. Routine is demanding, but it is held up rather than broken. Mercury: reversed-strong. What this means for you Interpretation : Your mind is one of the chart's quiet strengths. The exchange with Mars and the emerging phase turn a peregrine Mercury into an active, incisive interpreter. Expect pressure (Saturn's opposition) that sharpens rather than silences it. Venus: strong-in-shadow. What this means for you Interpretation : Your Venus is at home but hidden: affection, taste and alliances work privately and through shared money and partners' resources. In the Fortune chart she is at the top, so this hidden Venus is where material luck becomes visible. Mars: reversed-strong. What this means for you Interpretation : Mars out of sect on your setting angle is not plain trouble. The exchange with Mercury and the morning phase turn its force into strategic, argumentative competence in partnerships and contracts. Rivals sharpen you, and the friction is productive when you use reason (Mercury) as the weapon. Jupiter: strong. What this means for you Interpretation : This is the chart's anchor: you are self-ruled, decent and supported, and your good returns after setbacks. The retrograde, setting-side condition makes it inward and slow-built rather than showy. Saturn: cancelled (harm cancelled; acts constructively). What this means for you Interpretation : Saturn's harm is cancelled. In sect, lord of your Fortune and bonified by Jupiter, it acts as a builder: slow gains, patience, lasting structures. The one cost is pressure on daily life (its square to the Moon). House-by-house walk-through: from the Ascendant and from Fortune Calculated Place What is there Reading Interpretation Counted from Fortune 1 Pisces Ascendant, Jupiter (ruler) Self supported by its own lord: steady identity, goodwill from Fortune: 3rd (siblings, short journeys, worship) 2 Aries empty; lord Mars in 7th Livelihood earned through partners, contracts and rivals 4th from Fortune 3 Taurus Saturn R Saturn in a growth place (malefic in 3rd, a hard-work place): persistence with siblings, writing, local travel 5th from Fortune (good) 4 Gemini Lot of Spirit; lord Mercury in 9th Purpose rooted in home and property, directed by study 6th from Fortune 5 Cancer empty; lord Moon in 6th Children and pleasure tied to work and duty; current profection year 7th from Fortune 6 Leo Moon Daily labour and service carry the Moon: busy, obligated routine 8th from Fortune 7 Virgo Mars (angular) Partners and open opponents are energetic and competitive 9th from Fortune 8 Libra Sun, Venus Shared resources, others' money, hidden authority 10th from Fortune: the material peak place 9 Scorpio Mercury God, travel, study: the interpreter's place 11th from Fortune (good) 10 Sagittarius MC 25°; lord Jupiter rising Public role is empty but its lord is on the Ascendant: reputation follows character 12th from Fortune 11 Capricorn Lot of Fortune; lord Saturn Good Daemon: material luck through friends and allies, slow 1st from Fortune 12 Aquarius empty; lord Saturn Hidden troubles governed by the in-sect, constructive Saturn: manageable 2nd from Fortune What this means for you Interpretation : From the Ascendant your weight is in hidden and cadent places (6, 8, 9, 3), which marks a private, behind-the-scenes life. Counted from Fortune the picture turns over: Sun and Venus stand at the 10th, Mercury at the 11th, Saturn at the 5th. Your material and practical success sits exactly where the Ascendant chart looks weakest: shared resources, partners and study. Revisions to earlier readings Interpretation : Readings in §0–§13 that leaned on bare dignity are revised as follows. The "Sun in fall = weak point" becomes strong-in-shadow . "Venus under the beams in a bad place" becomes strong-in-shadow . "Mercury peregrine" becomes reversed-strong (exchange plus phasis). "Mars out of sect in the 7th = trouble from others" becomes reversed-strong : competitive but productive. "Saturn retrograde, peregrine" becomes cancelled : constructive. The Moon remains the one genuinely weak placement, mitigated. Jupiter's face is corrected to the second decan (§2). Synthesis: one genuinely weak planet (Moon), two strong-in-shadow (Sun, Venus), two reversed-strong (Mercury, Mars), one cancelled malefic (Saturn) and one strong anchor (Jupiter).

Whole-sign aspects and overcoming Calculated Whole-sign aspects, with degree separation from the exact aspect: - Sun–Venus copresent, 4.2° apart - Moon–Mercury square, 4.7°; the Moon overcomes Mercury by decimation - Moon–Venus sextile, 8.6°, applying - Saturn–Moon square, 6.6°; Saturn overcomes the Moon by decimation (Saturn in the 10th from the Moon) - Moon–Sun sextile, 12.8° - Mercury–Saturn opposition, 1.8° - Mercury–Jupiter trine, 16.9°; Mercury overcomes Jupiter - Mercury–Mars sextile, 1.1°; Mars overcomes Mercury - Mars–Jupiter opposition, 15.8° - Saturn–Mars trine, 2.9° - Jupiter–Saturn sextile, 18.8°; Jupiter overcomes Saturn Antiochus and Porphyry define maltreatment Source, verify : a malefic in the same sign, opposite, overcoming by square, enclosing, or ruling the bound. On those definitions: - The Moon is maltreated by Saturn's overcoming square. Saturn is the malefic of sect, which mitigates the harm. - Mercury is maltreated by Saturn's close opposition. It is helped by Jupiter's trine, and the Jupiter trine counts as bonification. Mercury is also linked to Mars by a near-exact sextile with Mars overcoming. Mercury stands in Mars's own sign and bound. - The Sun is bonified by Venus in the same sign. - Jupiter is opposed by out-of-sect Mars. - Enclosure (emperischesis) was tested by sign and by casting of rays within 7°, and none was found. The planets on either side of Libra are Mars and Mercury, but neither forms a malefic pair. What this means for you Interpretation : The most exact contacts are Mercury–Saturn (1.8°) and Mercury–Mars (1.1°). That puts Mercury, your mind and speech and the lord of your 4th and 7th places, under the strongest pressure in the chart. Ptolemy (III.13) reads Mercury with Saturn as a serious, deliberate, sceptical intellect, one drawn to old, hidden or difficult subjects, sometimes gloomy or suspicious. Mars adds quickness, combativeness and a technical bent Source, verify . Jupiter's trine moderates it. For relationships, Mercury rules your 7th, so partners and contracts carry that tested, argumentative quality. The Saturn–Moon decimation is Valens's classic picture of the body and daily life being "overseen" by a strict authority. Burdens in household and work routine arrive early and are carried dutifully. Because Saturn is in sect, these become structure rather than ruin. Synthesis: the mind (Mercury) is the chart's pressure-point: sharpened by Mars, weighted by Saturn, rescued by Jupiter.

Phases relative to the Sun The Moon: last separation and next application Calculated The 15° beams are crossed as follows: - Mercury is under the beams but emerges as an evening star 4.75 days after birth. That is within Valens's/Paulus's 7-day window, so it is making its phase (chrēmatizōn) Source, verify . - Venus is under the beams heading for its superior conjunction (16.5 days later), so it is setting heliacally. - Jupiter is retrograde, 27.8 days past opposition, and stations direct 30.8 days later. - Saturn is retrograde and reaches opposition to the Sun 10.0 days later (acronychal rising). - Mars is a visible morning star, 46° west of the Sun. - The Moon is waning, 287° from the Sun (past last quarter, in Ptolemy's cold quarter, I.8). It is slower than average and in south latitude rising toward the node. It separates from Mercury (square) and applies to Venus (sextile, 8.6°), with no kollesis within 3°. It is not void of course. It enters the beams 5.25 days after birth. - Spear-bearing : Venus, in its own domicile and rising before the Sun, spear-bears the Sun (Ptolemy, Porphyry 30). The Moon has no evening spear-bearer configured to it by aspect. Mars follows it in the next sign but in aversion. What this means for you Interpretation : A planet making its phase near birth "is busy" and shows up strongly in the life (Paulus 14 Source, verify ). For you that planet is Mercury. Learning, writing, trade, calculation and messages become a recognisable part of your life's activity. The Moon moving from Mercury to Venus describes your life's movement in Dorotheus's terms: from thought, talk and work (Mercury) toward love, pleasure and partnership (Venus). Many ancient readers took this as the native finding greater ease and affection later. Saturn's approaching opposition and Jupiter's slowing toward its station make both outer planets "stationary-strong". Jupiter and Saturn affect your life slowly and persistently, not by sudden turns. Venus spear-bearing the Sun is the one classical support for honour. Recognition, if it comes, comes through grace, art, friendship or a partner rather than through command. Synthesis: Mercury is the active planet. Venus is the escort of the Sun. The Moon is moving toward Venus.

Predominator search, Ptolemy III.2 Calculated / Source The predominator search (Ptolemy III.2) runs as follows: 1. The Sun is in the 8th equal place, which is not aphetic. 2. The Moon is in the 5th, also not aphetic. 3. The prenatal syzygy was the full moon of 5 Oct 1998, 20:12 UT (4:12 PM EDT). The Sun was above the earth at 12°22' Libra. 4. Rulers counted by five dignities over the Sun, the syzygy and the Ascendant: Venus 4, Saturn 4, Jupiter 3. Neither Venus nor Saturn is in an aphetic place. So the predominator is the Ascendant (20°39' Pisces) and the oikodespotēs is Jupiter . The variants: - Epaphroditus/Porphyry , if the 8th is admitted as a succedent: the Sun, with Venus as its oikodespotes [verify]. - Valens III : the Ascendant, as above. - Firmicus IV.19 dominus geniturae (lord of the sign the Moon enters next): Mercury [verify]. - Ptolemy III.13, ruler of the soul : Mercury (with Mars as its domicile lord). - Ptolemy IV.4, ruler of action : Mars (the morning star nearest the Sun that is not under the beams), connected to Mercury by domicile exchange. What this means for you Interpretation : Three main rulers emerge: Jupiter (the person), Mercury (the mind and the "master" in Firmicus) and Mars (the work). Ptolemy IV.4 gives Mars with Mercury: makers, engineers, people who work with tools, instruments, weapons or fire, and also argument and law Source, verify . In modern terms that means technical, mechanical, analytical or competitive work, often with or against a counterpart (Mars in the 7th). Jupiter as oikodespotes is the classical sign of a native whose overall life is "under a kindly lord": ethical, socially trusted, adequately provided for. Mercury as Firmicus's dominus suggests a life whose quality depends on intelligence and communication. Synthesis: Jupiter governs the person, Mercury the mind, Mars the trade.

All computed lots Lots in the wheel Calculated The day formulae give: - Fortune 7°50' Capricorn , 11th place. Its lord Saturn is in the 3rd and retrograde, and it trines Fortune. - Spirit 3°28' Gemini , 4th place. Its lord Mercury is in the 9th. - Eros 3°19' Leo (6th, with the Moon) - Necessity 25°41' Taurus (3rd) - Courage 24°35' Cancer (5th) - Victory 6°53' Capricorn (11th, with Fortune) - Nemesis 13°46' Cancer (5th) - Basis 16°18' Leo (6th) - Marriage: Valens 5°51' Virgo (7th, with Mars); Dorotheus 16°27' Pisces (1st) - Father 1°16' Libra (8th) - Mother 12°01' Capricorn (11th) - Siblings 9°25' Aquarius (12th) - Children 1°53' Taurus (3rd, with Saturn) - Exaltation 19°19' Virgo (7th) - Friends 25°22' Sagittarius (10th, on the MC) - Action 21°45' Capricorn (11th) The full list is in the table. What this means for you Interpretation : Valens (II) makes Fortune the body and material life, and Spirit the mind, intention and career. Fortune in the 11th, the "Good Daimon" place of friends, hopes and benefactors, together with Victory, is one of the best placements of Fortune in Valens's system. Material welfare comes through allies, networks and patrons. Its lord Saturn is slow, so money builds steadily, through property, land, long-term and inherited assets (Ptolemy IV.2 gives Saturn's wealth through building, agriculture and shipping Source, verify ), and only later. Spirit in the 4th, an angle, means your purpose is anchored in home, foundations, property and roots. Its lord Mercury in the 9th (travel, religion, learning) points your intentions toward study, foreign matters or teaching. Both marriage lots fall on the angular axis: Valens's in the 7th with Mars, Dorotheus's on the Ascendant. Relationships are central and vigorous, sometimes contested. The Lot of Friends falls on the Midheaven, so your reputation is made by your friends. Children in the 3rd with Saturn: few or later children Interpretation of Valens II, verify . Synthesis: body-fortune comes through friends (11th). Purpose rests in home (4th). Marriage sits on the angles.

Antiscia Dodecatemoria The 36 faces Calculated Antiscia: the Sun's antiscion falls at 9°40' Pisces and Venus's at 13°52' Pisces, both in the 1st place, within 7–11° of Jupiter. Jupiter's antiscion is 10°18' Libra, with the Sun and Venus. Dodecatemoria (×12): - Sun → Gemini (4th) - Moon → 0° Scorpio (9th, with Mercury) - Mercury → Sagittarius (10th) - Venus → Aries - Mars → Libra (with the Sun and Venus) - Jupiter → Libra - Saturn → Taurus (itself) - Ascendant → 7°48' Scorpio, within 5° of Mercury Monomoiria Source, verify scheme : Asc Mars, Sun Moon, Moon Sun, Jupiter Jupiter. Faces: Jupiter in its own face. The Ascendant is in the Mars face, the Sun in the Jupiter face, and the Moon in the Saturn face of Leo. What this means for you Interpretation : Firmicus (II.29) treats antiscia as hidden aspects. Your Sun and Venus "see" your Ascendant and Jupiter by reflection, even though they are averse by sign. The ancient correction to the hidden-lights reading is that what you value (Venus) and what you aim for (Sun) do reach your person indirectly. Valens uses the dodecatemoria as the planet's inner nature. Your Ascendant's twelfth-part falls on Mercury and your Moon's falls in Mercury's place. That repeats the earlier finding: your inner life is run by Mercury, which means thinking, interpreting and analysing. Saturn's twelfth-part falling on itself doubles its constancy. Synthesis: the minor techniques keep pointing to Mercury and to a hidden link between Jupiter and Venus.

Paranatellonta computed for the moment of birth Thema Mundi comparison Calculated Co-rising with the Ascendant were Algol (alt −1.9°) and Mirfak (+4.9°) of Perseus , and Capella (−3.5°). Andromeda (Mirach, +7.8°) had just risen. Ophiuchus (Rasalhague) was culminating (hour angle 0.06 h), with Vega near the meridian. Regulus, Denebola and Spica were near setting. Manilius V places the rising of Andromeda with the 12th degree of Pisces and treats Perseus as rising with Taurus Source, verify . Thema Mundi: 1 of 7 planets is in its world-nativity sign (Venus in Libra). What this means for you Interpretation : Manilius V gives the Andromeda-born a severe fate (the chained maiden) and the Perseus-born a rescuer's temperament: hunters, people who fight monsters Source, verify . With the exact co-rising of Perseus/Algol, Manilius's reading would favour the rescuer image: someone who steps in to free others. Ptolemy (I.9) gives Perseus a Jupiter–Saturn nature, which again echoes your two outer planets. The culmination of Ophiuchus (the serpent-holder) has no natal reading in Manilius that can be applied safely without the text [verify]. The Thema Mundi match of Venus only means Venus is "where it was at the world's birth", a further sign of its strength. Synthesis: the sky at the eastern horizon carried Perseus. That image is a protector's, not a ruler's.

docs.h: 10. Character, work, wealth (Ptolemy III.13, IV.2, IV.4; Firmicus III)
docs.t: Source, verify / Interpretation : Firmicus III on the planets by place, paraphrased: - Jupiter in the 1st (horoscope): honoured, trustworthy, wealthy enough, and a guardian of others. - Saturn in the 3rd: trouble with or through siblings, and serious religious attitudes. - Moon in the 6th: subordinate work and exposure to servants. - Mars in the 7th: quarrels with partners and danger in contests. - Sun in the 8th: slow advancement, inheritance, and a hidden life. - Venus in the 8th: gains through women or legacies, and late marriage. - Mercury in the 9th: interpreters, astrologers, priests, scholars of religion and dreams. Soul (Ptolemy III.13): Mercury, with Mars and Saturn, gives a nature that is sharp, critical, secretive, persistent and argumentative, softened by Jupiter's trine into lawfulness and good judgement. The Moon in a fixed fire sign with Saturn's square adds steadiness and pride, at the cost of slowness to trust. Action (IV.4): Mars with Mercury points to technical, mechanical, investigative or competitive trades. Wealth (IV.2): the lord of Fortune, Saturn, is in sect and trines Fortune, so wealth is gathered slowly through property and long holding. What this means for you Interpretation : Ancient readers would describe a man who is likeable and principled in person (Jupiter rising) but critical and wary in mind (Mercury–Saturn). He does skilled, problem-solving work, often in a partnership or facing an opponent (Mars in the 7th). His money comes through networks and patient holding (Fortune in the 11th under Saturn), not through luck or rank. He has a real pull toward learning, belief and interpretation (Mercury in the 9th). Synthesis: Jupiter is the person, Mercury the mind, Mars the craft, Saturn the money.

docs.h: 12. How this school sees your body
docs.t: Zodiacal melothesia applied to the natal placements Portrait drawn only from the cited traits Ptolemy (III.11) takes bodily form from the rising sign, its lords and the planets rising, with the Moon's lord as a secondary factor. Here the rising lord and the rising planet are the same: Jupiter, occidental (evening), retrograde, in a water sign . - Complexion : light or white, but "not in a good way", i.e. pale rather than florid. Ptolemy III.11, Jupiter occidental Source, verify . - Hair : straight, with a tendency to baldness or thinning at the forehead. Ptolemy III.11, Jupiter occidental Source, verify . - Stature and build : medium. Ptolemy III.11, Jupiter occidental Source, verify . - Temperament (shaping the flesh): moister. Ptolemy III.11, Jupiter occidental. The Moon is in the last quarter, which Ptolemy I.8 calls the cold quarter, adding coolness Source, verify . - Face shape, eyes, nose, mouth : unspecified . Ptolemy's large-eyes trait belongs to Jupiter oriental , which does not apply. Valens I.2 and Firmicus give character, not features, for Pisces rising, in the sources searched Source, verify . Planetary melothesia (Ptolemy, Tetrabiblos III.12) Calculated, added in refinement : Jupiter (strong) rules lungs and touch, Mercury (reversed-strong) tongue and thought, the Sun (strong-in-shadow) eyes and heart, Venus (strong-in-shadow) liver, Mars (reversed-strong) kidneys, Saturn (cancelled) right ear and bones, and the Moon (weak, mitigated) stomach. Zodiacal melothesia (Manilius II.453ff; IV.701ff): Pisces governs the feet (Ascendant and Jupiter), Taurus the neck (Saturn), Leo the heart and sides (Moon), Virgo the belly (Mars), Libra the loins (Sun, Venus), Scorpio the groin (Mercury). These are given as cosmic correspondences only, with no medical claim. The portrait is a generic, fictional face in Roman-Egyptian Fayum panel style, the funerary-portrait convention of the period these texts come from.

Who is he? Interpretation A Pisces-rising, day-born native whose own lord Jupiter is at home on the rising degree. That makes him self-ruled, decent and trusted. His strengths are in shadow: a ruling Sun and a domicile Venus that work through partners and shared resources, and a Mercury and Mars made strong by exchange, giving a sharp, argumentative, interpretive mind. What this means for you: your best work is done through people and quietly, not on display. Is he here to serve? Interpretation The school does not frame a life as a mission. The Moon in the 6th under Saturn's square puts duty and labour into daily life, and Jupiter on the Ascendant gives a protective role (Firmicus III Source, verify ). What this means for you: service here means obligation and guardianship you carry by choice, not a calling given from outside. Is he a prophesied figure? Calculated/Interpretation Marker by marker (§13): the person-centred markers are present for the Sibylline eastern king, the Eclogue's returning Virgo and Saturnian reign, the kosmokrator's decan channel, the royal Ascendant criteria, the Augustan Capricorn and the tauroctony axis. The luminary-rank markers and the world-event markers are not present or not given in birth data. What this means for you: the chart speaks these figures' language in the self and the decans, and not in the lights. Does he have powers? Interpretation The tradition recognises no supernatural powers in nativities. Mercury in the 9th (god, oracles), emerging into phasis and reversed-strong by exchange with Mars, is the interpreter's signature (Valens, Firmicus Source, verify ). What this means for you: a real aptitude for interpretation, study and hidden subjects, not powers.

The nature. Read from the hour-marker outward, as Valens reads, the chart opens on Jupiter: the day benefic and Ascendant lord, in its own house and face, 0.9° from the rising degree, overcoming Saturn and trining Mercury. This is a well-supported self. Its retrograde, evening condition makes the good inward and slow-built. Hidden strength. Placement first changes the picture of earlier rounds. The Sun in fall in the 8th is the sect light rejoicing above the earth, guarded by Venus in her own sign and at the top of the Fortune chart: strong-in-shadow. Venus is the same. Mercury and Mars exchange signs and see each other, so both are reversed-strong. Saturn is in sect, lord of Fortune and bonified by Jupiter, so its harm is cancelled. Only the Moon (6th, waning, decimated by Saturn) remains genuinely weak, and the Sun's reception mitigates it. Mind and work. Mercury in the 9th, about to make its phasis and exchanged with Mars, gives an incisive interpreter's mind under Saturn's exacting opposition. Work runs through the 7th: partners, contracts and rivals, met with argument rather than force. Wealth. Fortune in Capricorn, ruled by the in-sect Saturn trine to it, gives slow gains through friends (11th place). From Fortune, the Sun and Venus stand at the 10th, so material success comes through shared resources and partners. Prophecy. The person-centred and decan markers of the eastern king, the Eclogue's child and the kosmokrator are present: the king-planet rising in the east at home, Virgo on the angle, Saturn's kingdom at Fortune, the Pisces III decan of Italy rising with Equus and Pegasus, and the initial Κ. The luminary-rank and world-event markers are not. Time. The 2026–27 profection is Cancer (5th, the Moon as year lord). Main windows: 2028–29 (7th profection with Fortune in Aries: partnerships and initiative), 2031–32 (10th profection with Spirit at the 10th from Spirit: career peak), 2037–38 (Fortune at Libra: material peak). Bottom line. A self-ruled private nativity whose strength lies in shadow, in partners, shared resources and interpretation. It speaks the prophetic figures' language through the Ascendant and the decans, not through the lights.

docs.t: Unless stated otherwise, all positions come from the computed chart in /workspace/hel02 (Skyfield DE440s). Day chart. "Degree n" means the span from n−1°00′ to n−1°59′. 16.1 Ptolemaic bounds checked against the text Source, verified Calculated Ptolemy's own bound table ( Tetrabiblos I.21, Robbins, LacusCurtius transcription) was checked sign by sign. The round-1 "Ptolemaic" table came from Lilly and differs from Robbins in Taurus, Gemini, Leo, Libra, Capricorn and Pisces. Hephaistio I.1 (Greenbaum-era translation, archive.org) gives the "according to Ptolemy" bounds for each sign. It agrees with Robbins except in Leo (Ju 6, Ve 6, Me 7, Sa 6, Ma 5) and Sagittarius (Ju 8, Ve 5, Me 5, Sa 6, Ma 6). Robbins prints the last Libra bound as ♄; this must be ♂, because Saturn already holds the first Libra bound. Using Robbins, only one placement changes. The Sun's Ptolemaic bound changes from Mercury to Jupiter (Libra 16°–24°). On Hephaistio's variant, the Moon (7°31′ Leo) falls in Venus' bound, not Mercury's. Every other point keeps its round-1 Ptolemaic lord. Bound lords compared What this means for you Interpretation : Under both the Egyptian and the corrected Ptolemaic tables, your Sun now sits in Jupiter's bound. Jupiter is your Ascendant lord and stands on the Ascendant, so the father, authority and the "public self" signified by the fallen Sun are steadied by the same benefic that steadies you. Round 1 read a Mercurial tone here (critical, verbal). That reading is withdrawn for Ptolemy's system. 16.2 Chaldean bounds Source, verified: Ptolemy I.21 Calculated Ptolemy describes the Chaldean system as follows. Bounds run 8, 7, 6, 5, 4 degrees, and the order is set by triplicity. By day Saturn precedes Mercury. The results for this chart are: Point Chaldean bound lord Sun Mars Moon Jupiter Mercury Mars Venus Mars Mars Venus Jupiter Venus Saturn Venus Ascendant Venus Midheaven Mercury Fortune Venus Spirit Saturn Ptolemy himself calls this system "simple" and less plausible than his own. What this means for you Interpretation : Chaldean bounds give Venus a lot of weight in this chart: she holds the bounds of the Ascendant, Jupiter, Saturn, Mars and Fortune. This system would describe the body and fortunes as softened by taste, affection and agreement. It would also give Mars a say in the Libra pair (Sun and Venus), which supports round 1's picture of tested partnerships. Ptolemy ranks this system lowest, so treat it as a minor voice. 16.3 Monomoiria: order variant Source, verified: Ptolemy I.22 Ptolemy I.22 says the single degrees are assigned "according to the Chaldean order of the terms". Round 1 assigned them by the Chaldean planetary order starting from the sign's lord. That is a different, later (Paulus-style) scheme. Both are flagged as variants. No reading in §15 depended on the monomoiria. What this means for you Interpretation : Nothing in the integrated reading changes. This entry records that the "degree lords" are not uniform across the tradition, so no single-degree claim should carry weight. 16.4 Bright, dark, smoky, void, masculine/feminine, pitted, azimene and increasing-fortune degrees Calculated The tables come from two sources: - Lilly, Christian Astrology p.116. These are later, Arabic-derived tables, also found in al-Biruni and Schoener. They are not Hellenistic. - Hephaistio I.1 "bright degrees". This is a genuine Hellenistic list, verified in the archive.org text. Key hits: - Jupiter (degree 20 of Pisces) is both a Lilly "degree increasing fortune" and a Hephaistio bright degree. - Venus (degree 17 of Libra) is a Hephaistio bright degree and a Lilly "light" degree. - The Midheaven (degree 26 of Sagittarius) is a Hephaistio bright degree. - The Sun (degree 21 of Libra) is a Lilly increasing-fortune degree. Lilly applies these degrees to the Ascendant, the 2nd, Jupiter and Fortune, not to the Sun. - No point falls in a pitted or azimene degree. The column layout in the Lilly extraction is ambiguous for pitted degrees, so treat that as "probably none". - The Ascendant (degree 21 of Pisces) is masculine and dark. It is not bright in Hephaistio's list (Pisces 8, 15, 20, 23, 25, 30). Degree qualities What this means for you Interpretation : Your Ascendant ruler sits in a degree marked favourable in two independent lists, one ancient and one medieval. It is a small, technical endorsement of round 1's main finding: Jupiter is the chart's anchor. The Ascendant degree itself is "dark", which in Lilly's terms means a less showy, less conspicuous presence. That fits round 1's quiet, inward Jupiter. Nothing marks a defect (no pitted or azimene degree). 16.5 More lots from Firmicus VI.32 Source, verified: Kroll–Skutsch Latin, LacusCurtius Calculated Firmicus VI.32 gives a set of "partiliter" lots. Each runs from planet A to planet B and is projected from the Ascendant. Day formulas are used here. The lot of illness and the lot of burial are deliberately omitted, and so is "virtus corporis" (bodily strength), to keep to the health policy. docs.h: 2. The Talmudic layer: mazzal of the day and of the hour (Shabbat 156a)
docs.t: 2.1 Mazzal of the day (R. Joshua ben Levi). Calculated Before sunset on Tuesday (the third day, yom shlishi). Source, confirmed: Shabbat 156a Shabbat 156a: "One born on the third day will be wealthy and unchaste (ashir ve-zinai), because herbs were created on it." Rashi explains that the grasses multiply quickly and mix with one another. What this means for you. The third day stands for fertility and spread: things grow fast around you, including resources and appetites. The Talmud's warning goes with the gift: abundance needs boundaries. On R. Hanina's view the day matters less than the hour (below). 2.2 Mazzal of the hour (R. Hanina: "mazzal sha'ah gorem"). Calculated The day hours (sunrise to sunset ÷ 12) were 56.2 minutes long. Birth at 17:25 EDT falls in day hour 11 . The Talmudic sequence Shabbetai–Tzedek–Ma'adim–Hamah–Nogah–Kokhav–Levanah (ShTzaM HaNKaL) gives Tuesday's first hour to Ma'adim. Counting forward, hour 11 belongs to Kokhav (Mercury) . The Talmud's tradition that the luminaries were hung on Tuesday evening at a Saturn hour confirms the reckoning: the hour after Tuesday's last day hour is Saturn's. Source, confirmed Shabbat 156a: "One born under Kokhav will be bright and wise (navor ve-hakim), because Kokhav is the Sun's scribe." What this means for you. docs.h: 3. Sefer Yetzirah: letters, faculties, mothers and doubles
docs.t: 3.1 Simple letters (Gra recension) Source, confirmed: Sefer Yetzirah 5, Gra version . Calculated The Sun is in Libra, which gives Lamed , month Tishri, faculty tashmish (coition). The Moon is in Leo, which gives Tet , month Av, faculty shemi'ah (hearing). The Ascendant is in Pisces, which gives Qof , month Adar, faculty sehok (laughter). The Gra text lists these three faculties exactly so. What this means for you. Lamed is the tallest letter, and its root means learning and teaching (lamad/limmed). Your Sun letter points to a life organised around learning and around union. Tet (the Moon) makes your emotional faculty hearing : you take in the world by listening. Qof (the rising sign) makes laughter the faculty you show. Together they describe someone who teaches, listens and lightens a room. The same letters also carry their shadow: tashmish untamed is appetite, and laughter can become mockery ( letzanut ). The school asks for both to be sanctified, not suppressed. 3.2 Mother letters. Calculated Libra is air, which gives Aleph . Leo is fire, which gives Shin . Pisces is water, which gives Mem . In the body (SY 3, "head created from fire, belly from water, chest from air") Source, confirmed; added in refinement , that puts Shin (Moon) in your head, Aleph (Sun) in your chest and Mem (Ascendant) in your belly; see Gallery 23. The three luminary points (Sun, Moon, Ascendant) take the three mothers, Aleph–Mem–Shin, exactly once each. Source, confirmed: SY 3, Gra What this means for you. Sefer Yetzirah presents AMSh as the balance of the universe: Shin's fire above, Mem's water below, and Aleph's air as "the tongue of the balance between them". Your Sun is the Aleph, the arbitrating middle. All three mothers are present in your three lights, which is the Yetzirah picture of a complete, balanced person. It fits a Libra Sun and the Talmudic "scribe" image: your role is to mediate between heat and depth. 3.3 Double letters (seven planets). Source, corrected The previous round printed Saadia's order under the Gra's name. The Gra version (SY 4) actually gives: Bet–Moon, Gimel–Mars, Dalet–Sun, Kaf–Venus, Peh–Mercury, Resh–Saturn, Tav–Jupiter . Saadia's recension assigns them differently, and that is where the old mapping came from. Calculated Using the Gra's own list: your strongest planet, Jupiter (domicile, rising), carries Tav , the last letter, whose pair in the Gra is grace/ugliness ( hen/ki'ur ). Mars, which the hidden-strength rules lift to strong (§5.3), carries Gimel (wealth/poverty). Your hour planet Mercury carries Peh , the mouth (seed/desolation in the Gra order). The weak Sun carries Dalet , the weak Saturn Resh , and the received Moon Bet . What this means for you. The doubles are pairs because each planet can turn either way. Tav, the seal letter, on your rising Jupiter says that grace ( hen ) is the quality that will be stamped on you if you live up to it, and its opposite is the risk if you do not. Peh on Mercury (the mouth) makes speech the faculty that decides whether your hour-gift bears fruit or lays waste. Gimel on a strong Mars puts wealth in the hands of your drive. 3.4 Directions. Source, corrected In the Gra's twelve diagonal boundaries Lamed (Libra) is the upper-west edge, not "north-west" as printed before. Tet (Leo) is south-east and Qof (Pisces) is lower-north . What this means for you. Your three lights stand on three different edges of the cube of space: the upper west, the south-east and the lower north. In Yetzirah's picture that is a person stretched across the whole structure rather than gathered in one corner. It gives breadth, and it means you must work at keeping a centre. 3.5 The 231 gates (C6, now complete). Calculated All 231 two-letter gates of the 22 letters (SY 2:4, "231 gates, forward and back") were generated. Taking the letters his chart activates in the Gra scheme (Sun, Moon and Ascendant simples Lamed, Tet and Qof; the mothers Aleph, Mem and Shin; the doubles of all seven planets; and the simples of the signs holding the other planets: Vav for Taurus, Nun for Scorpio, Yod for Virgo), 16 letters are lit: אב אג אד או אט אי אכ אל אמ אנ אפ אק אר אש את בג בד בו בט בי בכ בל במ בנ בפ בק בר בש בת גד גו גט גי גכ גל גמ גנ גפ גק גר גש גת דו דט די דכ דל דמ דנ דפ דק דר דש דת וט וי וכ ול ומ ונ ופ וק ור וש ות טי טכ טל טמ טנ טפ טק טר טש טת יכ יל ימ ינ יפ יק יר יש ית כל כמ כנ כפ כק כר כש כת למ לנ לפ לק לר לש לת מנ מפ מק מר מש מת נפ נק נר נש נת פק פר פש פת קר קש קת רש רת שת. They form 120 of the 231 gates . The core gates among the luminary and rising letters with the rising Jupiter's Tav are six: לט, לק, לת, טק, טת, קת . Read in both directions, the primary pair Lamed–Qof gives kal (קל), "light, swift", and the reversed Tet–Lamed gives tal (טל), "dew". The 231 gates: the 120 between his chart letters in gold, the six core gates (Lamed, Tet, Qof, Tav) in red What this means for you. Sefer Yetzirah does not give a reading for single gates; it describes all creation as built by permuting them. Your core six give two plain Hebrew words: kal , lightness and speed, and tal , dew, which in the liturgy of Tishri is the blessing that falls without effort (the prayer for dew, Tal). As meditations Interpretation they suit a chart whose gifts come quickly and quietly. The large count (120 gates) simply reflects that a chart with planets in many signs touches many letters. It is not a mark of distinction. Micrography carpet page: Lamed, the Tishri/Libra letter, over the Scales, with the Pisces star and fishes below (AI artwork) Synthesis §3. In letters, you are Lamed–Tet–Qof: learning, hearing, laughter. In the mothers, you are the Aleph between fire and water. In the doubles (Gra), Tav's grace sits on your strongest planet and Peh's mouth on your hour planet.

docs.h: 4. The Baraita de-Mazzalot, Mashallah and Sefer Raziel
docs.t: 4.1 Planet of the day and of the hour. Source, confirmed for Shabbat 156a; the Baraita de-Mazzalot itself unverified The Baraita de-Mazzalot and the Shabbat sugya agree on the planets' natures: Mars, the "red" one (Ma'adim, from adom), gives a person who sheds blood, for good as surgeon, mohel or slaughterer, or for ill. Mercury gives intellect and craft. What this means for you. Your Mars contribution (the day) is drive and the ability to cut decisively. Your Mercury contribution (the hour) is skill and learning. Shabbat 156a's advice for the Mars-born is to channel the blood-letting impulse into a lawful craft, and that is the school's model for your temper. 4.2 Sign descriptions (Mashallah / ibn Ezra Reshit Hokhmah ch. 2). [Source, confirmed for Reshit Hokhmah ch. 2 in the Levy–Cantera translation: Pisces "its anatomical part comprises the feet and toes", watery, northern, feminine, double-bodied] Pisces is a double-bodied, watery, northern, feminine sign, Jupiter's house and the exaltation of Venus. Natives of a Pisces ascendant are changeable, travel much, love the sea and water, and are gentle and religious. Libra is a cardinal (hafikhah), airy, masculine, day sign; it gives a love of justice, measure and trade. Leo is a fixed, fiery, royal sign of the Sun; it gives pride, generosity and leadership. What this means for you. The rising sign, by the most-weighted rule, is a gentle, adaptable, water-loving, pious temperament. Underneath is a Libran sense of fairness, and the Moon adds a Leonine need for dignity and recognition in the emotions. 4.3 Angels of the planets and the hours (Sefer Raziel, D3/D4 now complete). Source, confirmed / corrected against the Savedow translation of Sefer Raziel ha-Malakh The text held gives Samael for Mars (Tuesday), Tzedeqial for Jupiter, Gabriel for the Moon, Raphael for the Sun and Michael for Mercury. The month angel of Tishri is Tzorial . Source, unverified The names Kafziel (Saturn) and Anael (Venus) printed last round do not appear in this Raziel text; they come from later Christian and Agrippa-type lists, so they are marked unverified and not used. Calculated With the hour-angels attached to the Chaldean hour sequence, the birth hour (day hour 11, Mercury) belongs to Michael , the day to Samael, and the rising planet to Tzedeqial. What this means for you. In Raziel's scheme you were born on Samael's day, at Michael's hour, with Tzedeqial's planet rising. Samael's day is force, which Shabbat 156a tells the Mars-born to channel into lawful work. Michael's hour is the hour of the guardian of Israel (Dan. 12:1) and the angel of Mercury's learning. Tzedeqial, "the righteousness of God", repeats the rising-Jupiter theme: your best power is righteousness, not influence. Tzorial, Tishri's month angel, carries the month's theme of judgement. Synthesis §4. Pisces gentleness on the surface, Libran measure in the core, Leonine pride in the heart. Mars's day-energy should be turned into craft.

docs.h: 5. Abraham ibn Ezra: dignities, the ruler of the nativity, hidden strength
docs.t: 5.1 Essential dignity (Reshit Hokhmah ch. 7: domicile 5, exaltation 4, triplicity 3, term 2, face 1). Calculated Dignity table: Egyptian terms, Chaldean faces, Dorothean day triplicity lords Planet Lord Exalt. Trip. (day) Term Face Score Sun 20°20' Libra Venus Saturn Saturn Jupiter Jupiter −4 (fall) Moon 7°30' Leo Sun — Sun Venus Saturn 0 peregrine Mercury 2°47' Scorpio Mars — Venus Mars Mars 0 peregrine Venus 16°08' Libra Venus Saturn Saturn Jupiter Saturn +5 domicile Mars 3°53' Virgo Mercury Mercury Venus Mercury Sun 0 peregrine Jupiter 19°42' Pisces Jupiter Venus Venus Mars Jupiter +6 domicile + face Saturn 0°56' Taurus Venus Moon Venus Venus Mercury 0 peregrine What this means for you. Two planets carry the chart: Jupiter (character and conduct) and Venus (relationships, taste, money). Four are peregrine, "strangers in a foreign house" in ibn Ezra's image, and the Sun is in its fall. That is a common distribution, neither royal nor broken. 5.2 The ruler of the nativity (almuten). Calculated Summing positive dignities over the five hylegical points (Sun, Moon, Ascendant, Lot of Fortune, prenatal full moon at 12°22' Aries) gives Venus 17 , Sun 16, Saturn 12, Mars 12, Jupiter 8, Mercury 2, Moon 0. The lord of the rising sign is Jupiter, and the planet on the ascendant is Jupiter. What this means for you. Ibn Ezra's two candidates for "the significator of the native" are the almuten (Venus) and the ascendant lord (Jupiter): the two benefics, and both dignified. This is the main reason the school would call the nativity fortunate in character . Venus makes you a person of harmony, beauty, partnership and fair dealing. Jupiter makes you one of trust, learning and generosity. 5.3 HIDDEN STRENGTH, recomputed by ibn Ezra's own rules. Source, confirmed from Reshit Hokhmah (Levy–Cantera) and corrected where round 1 erred Rules applied: (a) reception : a planet applying to the lord of its sign or of one of its dignities is received, and (clause 2) the planet applied to is also received when it stands in a dignity of the applier; (b) house strength : angles strongest, succedent next, cadent weakest; (c) phase : the superiors (Saturn, Jupiter, Mars) have "excellent dignity" when east of the Sun from heliacal rising to the sextile, diminishing to the square, and none after that until the station; the inferiors (Venus, Mercury, Moon) are strong when west of the Sun; (d) hayz (a diurnal planet above the horizon by day in a masculine sign, and so on; the Sun takes the masculine-sign condition except in Libra); (e) sect; (f) combustion and under the beams; (g) retrogradation. Calculated Planet Placement in context Rules that fire Net verdict Sun 20°20' Libra, 8th place (a cadent "bad place"), in fall; sect light above the horizon fall-4; house8:2; bad-place; hayz+1; in-sect; Venus applies from its own dignity-sign host role: Sun received by Venus (IE clause 2)+2. Correction: Venus applies to the Sun while the Sun is in Venus's dignity, so by clause 2 the Sun is received. weak, eased (received by Venus; the fall is not cancelled) Moon 7°30' Leo, 6th place, out of sect house6:1; bad-place; out-of-sect; east of Sun-1 (IE); received by Sun (60°,applying)+2. Correction: round 1 said "no reception". In fact the Moon applies by sextile to the Sun, lord of Leo (12.8° orb, within the moieties), so it is received. weak, but received Mercury 2°47' Scorpio, 9th place, under the beams house9:1; out-of-sect; west of Sun+1 (IE); under beams-1; received by Mars (60°,applying)+2. Mercury west of the Sun (evening star) is strong for an inferior planet, and it applies to Mars, lord of Scorpio, by an almost exact sextile (1.1°): received. strong-in-shadow Venus 16°08' Libra, 8th place, domicile, combust domicile+5; house8:2; bad-place; out-of-sect; east of Sun-1 (IE); combust-3 strong-in-shadow (domicile power hidden by the Sun's rays) Mars 3°53' Virgo, 7th place (angular) house7:3; hayz+1; out-of-sect; oriental-excellent+2 (IE); Mercury applies from its own dignity-sign host role: Mars received by Mercury (IE clause 2)+2. Correction: Mars is east of the Sun within the sextile zone, ibn Ezra's "excellent dignity", and in hayz. cancelled, then strong Jupiter 19°42' Pisces, 1st place, on the Ascendant domicile+5; face+1; house1:3; in-sect; no phase dignity (IE); retrograde-2 strong Saturn 0°56' Taurus, 3rd place, retrograde house3:1; in-sect; no phase dignity (IE); retrograde-2; received by Moon (90°,separating)+1 weak Ibn Ezra's rules applied to each planet, with the net verdicts What this means for you. The corrected rules lift more than round 1 allowed. Mars , which looked like a peregrine stranger, is in fact in ibn Ezra's best phase, angular and in hayz: your drive is genuinely strong, and it works through partners and opponents (the 7th place). Mercury is strong by being an evening star and by its reception from Mars: a mind that is better than it looks, best in writing and counsel. Venus rules the nativity from under the Sun's rays, so your care for relationships and beauty is real, but you tend to fold it into another's light. The Sun and Moon are each received, so they are not left helpless, but they stay weak: public authority and emotional security are things you build, not things you are given. Saturn is plainly weak: endurance and slow structure are your least natural gifts and need deliberate practice. 5.4 Aspects (ibn Ezra's moieties). Calculated Sun–Venus conjunction 4.2°. Mercury–Saturn opposition 1.8°. Mercury–Mars sextile 1.1° (with reception). Mars–Saturn trine 2.9°. Moon square Mercury 4.7° and Moon square Saturn 6.6° (a fixed-sign T). Moon sextile Venus 8.6°. Sun opposite Saturn 10.6° (out of sign: Libra–Taurus is not an opposition by sign, so ibn Ezra would weight it lightly). Jupiter conjunct the Ascendant 0.95°. What this means for you. The Mercury–Saturn opposition across the 9th and 3rd places (belief and study against near surroundings and siblings) is the chart's main intellectual tension: a serious, sceptical, sometimes heavy mind that has to argue its way to faith. The Moon's squares to the same pair say feelings can be stung by criticism and slowed by duty. The trine from Mars to Saturn gives the stamina to finish hard work. 5.5 Where is what: placement-first walk through the twelve places (Sefer ha-Moladot). Calculated; meanings Source, confirmed for the place-significations in Reshit Hokhmah ch. 3 Whole-sign places from the Pisces Ascendant, with lords and occupants Place Sign (lord) Occupants Lord's condition and where it sits What this means for you 1 self, body Pisces (Jupiter) Jupiter , 0°57' from the Ascendant Jupiter at home in its own place: strong Your person carries the chart. Goodwill, trust and an even temperament are what people meet first. 2 money Aries (Mars) — Mars in the 7th, strong Income comes through partners, clients and contests; you earn by engaging others, not alone. 3 siblings, study, short trips Taurus (Venus) Saturn (weak, retrograde) Venus in the 8th, strong-in-shadow Siblings and near surroundings carry weight and duty; study is serious and slow. A malefic in the 3rd, which ibn Ezra counts among the places where malefics do less harm, is the chart's mildest placement for Saturn. 4 father, home, end of matters Gemini (Mercury) Lot of Spirit, Lot of Work Mercury in the 9th, strong-in-shadow Home is a place of learning; your work (Lot of Work) has roots in the home. 5 children, joy Cancer (Moon) Lot of Courage Moon in the 6th, weak but received Pleasure and children are tied to work and care; joy has to be made room for. 6 service, servants Leo (Sun) Moon , North Node, Lot of Eros Sun in the 8th, weak but eased Service is emotionally central to you, and much of your feeling life is lived through duty. 7 partner, opponents Virgo (Mercury) Mars (strong), Lot of Marriage Mercury in the 9th A capable, critical, energetic partner; strong contests and strong partnerships. Your power shows most in one-to-one dealings. 8 others' goods, hidden matters Libra (Venus) Sun, Venus , Lots of Father and Wealth Venus at home here Shared resources, partners' money and inheritances favour you; much of your identity works behind the scenes. 9 faith, wisdom, travel Scorpio (Mars) Mercury , Lots of Enemies and Nemesis Mars in the 7th, strong A deep, probing mind on faith and far subjects; arguments over belief are part of your road. 10 rule, work Sagittarius (Jupiter) MC 25°00', Lot of Faith Jupiter on the Ascendant, strong Your vocation flows from character: teaching, judgement, counsel, religion. 11 friends, hopes Capricorn (Saturn) Lots of Fortune, Mother, Victory Saturn in the 3rd, weak Fortune and success come through friends and patrons, slowly, and need steady effort. 12 hidden enemies, confinement Aquarius (Saturn) Lot of Brothers Saturn weak Little in this place; hidden trouble is limited, but what there is concerns siblings and is slow to clear. What this means for you. Read placement-first, the chart's centre of gravity is the axis of the 1st and 7th: Jupiter on you, Mars on the other. You are a person defined by good character meeting strong partners and strong opponents. The 8th and 6th, the "bad places", hold both lights. That is the structural reason the Sun and Moon read weak, and it says that identity and feeling are worked out through others' resources and through service, not through public display. 5.6 Lots (Sefer ha-Moladot; day formulas). Calculated Fortune 7°49' Capricorn (11th place). Spirit/Future 3°28' Gemini (4th). Father 1°15' Libra (8th). Mother 12°01' Capricorn (11th). Brothers 9°25' Aquarius (12th). Marriage (men) 5°51' Virgo (7th). Children 1°53' Taurus (3rd). Eros 3°18' Leo (6th). Necessity 25°41' Taurus (3rd). Courage 24°35' Cancer (5th). Victory 6°53' Capricorn (11th). Nemesis 27°32' Scorpio (9th). Work 27°12' Gemini (4th) Calculated, corrected: round 1 had a formula error . Faith 25°22' Sagittarius (10th). Wealth 16°45' Libra (8th). Enemies 17°42' Scorpio (9th). Travel 16°45' Taurus (3rd). Source, confirmed: Fortune by Ptolemy's formula; the Mother lot as in Reshit Hokhmah ch. 9 What this means for you. Fortune in Saturn's Capricorn in the place of friends says that material good comes through networks and patrons, slowly and by steady effort. The Marriage lot falls in the 7th place, the partnership place, which is the simplest signature of a significant marriage. Spirit in Mercury's Gemini, in the 4th, puts the mind's purpose in home, roots and family learning, and the corrected Lot of Work falls in the same sign: your work is meant to come out of that home base. The Lot of Faith on the 10th-place sign joins belief to vocation. 5.7 Faces and mansions. Calculated Decans (Chaldean faces): Sun in Libra III (Jupiter's face), Moon in Leo I (Saturn's face), Ascendant in Pisces III (Mars's face). The 28 mansions in equal divisions from 0° Aries [Source, unverified: the mansion list is Arabic, and it was not found in Reshit Hokhmah ; round 1's attribution to ibn Ezra is withdrawn]: Moon in 10, al-Jabhah (the Forehead [of the Lion]) ; Sun and Venus in 16, al-Zubana (the Claws [of the Scorpion]) ; Ascendant and Jupiter in 28, Batn al-Hut (the Belly of the Fish) . The 28 mansions (Arabic list; not in Reshit Hokhmah) with his Moon, Sun, Venus, Jupiter and Ascendant What this means for you. In the Arabic electional lists, al-Jabhah is a mansion of strength and building and al-Zubana one of commerce and agreements Source, unverified . Batn al-Hut, the last mansion, is the end of the circle, favourable for completions and for crossings of water. A Moon on the Lion's Forehead adds dignity and visibility to feeling. A Sun and Venus in the Claws are a merchant's or negotiator's placement. A rising point in the Belly of the Fish says you are oriented toward completion and synthesis. 5.8 Prenatal syzygy and trutina. Calculated The last syzygy before birth was the full moon of 5 Oct 1998, 20:12 UT, Moon at 12°22' Aries (lord Mars, in the 7th). The Hermes trutina rule (that the Moon at conception becomes the ascendant at birth, and vice versa) cannot be tested without a conception date. As a crude check, the birth Moon in Leo is not on the conception-ascendant degree that the rule would require Interpretation . What this means for you. A full moon in Aries before birth, ruled by Mars in the partnership angle, repeats the theme of drive expressed through others . 5.9 The great conjunction (Sefer ha-Olam; Abravanel). Calculated The Saturn–Jupiter conjunctions before birth were 31 Dec 1980 (9°29' Libra), 4 Mar 1981 (8°06' Libra) and 24 Jul 1981 (4°56' Libra), all in the air triplicity. The next was 28 May 2000 (22°43' Taurus). No Saturn–Jupiter conjunction falls in Pisces at any point from 1900 to 2100 (list computed: Capricorn 1901, Virgo 1921, Taurus 1940–41, Capricorn 1961, Libra 1980–81, Taurus 2000, Aquarius 2020, Libra 2040, Gemini 2060, Aquarius 2080, Libra 2100). What this means for you. You were born under a Libra great conjunction, and the natal Sun is also in Libra, so the era-sign and the Sun agree. For ibn Ezra, Libra conjunctions concern justice, law and balance between nations. See §10 for the messianic Pisces question. Calculated, round 2 The date of the next Pisces great conjunction (~2338) printed last round is withdrawn; it was not recomputed. Saturn–Jupiter conjunctions 1900–2100 (computed): none in Pisces; his birth in the Libra series Synthesis §5. Ibn Ezra would call this nativity good in its significators (Jupiter and Venus dignified, Jupiter rising), mixed in its luminaries (Sun in fall, Moon peregrine and cadent), and strong in hidden ways (Mars in its excellent phase, Mercury received, Venus at home under the beams).

docs.h: 6. The Hebrew calendar of the birth
docs.t: The Hebrew calendar data of the birth 6.1 Hebrew date. Calculated The birth came before sunset (17:25 against 18:39 EDT), so the date is Tuesday 23 Tishri 5759 . In the diaspora that is Simchat Torah ; in the Land of Israel it is Isru Chag, the day after the festival. What this means for you. Simchat Torah is the day the annual Torah reading ends (Vezot ha-Berakhah, Moses' blessing of the tribes) and immediately begins again (Bereshit). The tradition reads the day as joy in learning and as the circle without end, the last letter (Lamed of Yisrael ) joined to the first (Bet of Bereshit ), which together spell lev , heart Source, unverified; a well-known homily . It is a striking echo of your Lamed Sun. 6.2 Readings. Calculated/Source The day's reading is Deut. 33–34 with Gen. 1:1–2:3, and the haftarah is Joshua 1 ("Be strong and of good courage"). The parasha of the next Shabbat (17 Oct 1998) was Bereshit . What this means for you. The haftarah given to the birthday is the handover from Moses to Joshua: the follower who becomes the one who carries on. The school would read that as being a continuer and implementer rather than a founder. 6.3 Molad and tekufah. Calculated The molad of Tishri 5759 fell on Monday 21 Sep 1998 at 6h 55m and 15 parts a.m. (Jerusalem mean time; Rosh Hashanah was that Monday). Tekufat Tishri by Shmuel's year of 365¼ days fell on 7 Oct 1998 at 15:00, six days before the birth. The astronomical equinox was 23 Sep 1998, 05:37 UT. Rav Adda's year (365d 5h 997p 48r = 365.2468 days) is shown for comparison. What this means for you. You were born in the first week of tekufat Tishri, the autumn season ruled in the tradition by Libra's scales and the judgement of the Days of Awe. The year opened in the Moon's hour of a Monday molad: an emotional, receptive year-start. 6.4 Tribe, letter, divine-name permutation, stone. [Source, confirmed: month–tribe order via secondary citations of the Arizal / Bnei Yissaschar; breastplate birth order confirmed; the permutation VHYH partially confirmed (secondary sources only)] In the Arizal / Bnei Yissaschar month-tribe order (Nisan Judah, Iyar Issachar, Sivan Zebulun, Tammuz Reuben, Av Simeon, Elul Gad, Tishri Ephraim , Heshvan Manasseh, Kislev Benjamin, Tevet Dan, Shevat Asher, Adar Naphtali), Tishri belongs to Ephraim . Its letter is Lamed, its faculty tashmish, and its permutation of the Name is VHYH. Breastplate (Ex. 28:17–20; tribal allotments differ between Targum, Midrash Bamidbar Rabbah 2:7 and Rashi): Joseph's stone is usually given as the shoham (onyx) in the fourth row, Source, corrected Round 1 said Ephraim is sometimes given leshem . That is wrong: leshem is Dan's stone. Where Joseph is split, Ephraim takes the shoham. Illuminated-manuscript hoshen with the shoham (Joseph/Ephraim) stone lit (AI artwork; its tribal labels are decorative) What this means for you. Ephraim is Joseph's younger son, blessed by Jacob ahead of his elder brother (Gen. 48), and in the camp order the leader of the western camp. Its themes are fruitfulness ("Ephraim" = "made fruitful"), administration (Joseph governing Egypt) and being the one raised over the expected heir. For a man this also opens the Messiah-ben-Joseph question, which §10 tests marker by marker. 6.5 Year features. Calculated 5759 is year 2 of the 304th nineteen-year machzor, a common (twelve-month) year, and year 5 of the shemitah cycle (5761 was the shemitah). What this means for you. A common year in the middle of the sabbatical cycle: working years, not release or reset years. The school gives no special personal meaning beyond that. 6.6 Birthday psalm. Calculated The custom of reciting the psalm numbered by one's age plus one: you completed 28 years on 13 Oct 2026 (Hebrew birthday 23 Tishri 5787 = 4 Oct 2026), so the psalm for this year is Psalm 29 . It becomes Psalm 30 after 23 Tishri 5788 (24 Oct 2027). The birth-year psalm is Psalm 1. What this means for you. Psalm 29, "the voice of the Lord is upon the waters", has seven "voices" and a water image that suits a Pisces rising. It ends "The Lord will give strength (oz) to His people; the Lord will bless His people with peace (shalom)". Psalm 1, "Happy is the man... his delight is in the Torah of the Lord... like a tree planted by streams of water", again joins learning (Lamed) to water (Pisces). Synthesis §6. The calendar layer is unusually coherent for this chart: Simchat Torah, Lamed, Ephraim, Joshua 1 and Psalms 1 and 29 all speak of learning, continuity and fruitfulness by water . That is a symbolic harmony, not a prediction.

docs.h: 7. Kabbalistic correspondences: sefirot, paths, the 72 Names
docs.t: 7.1 Sefirot. Source, unverified against an edition this round The later standard scheme (Tikkunei Zohar and the Cordovero-era tables) pairs Saturn with Binah, Jupiter with Hesed, Mars with Gevurah, the Sun with Tiferet, Venus with Netzah, Mercury with Hod and the Moon with Yesod. Calculated With round 2's verdicts: Hesed (Jupiter) strong, Netzah (Venus) strong-in-shadow, Gevurah (Mars) strong, Hod (Mercury) strong-in-shadow, Tiferet (Sun) weak but eased, Yesod (Moon) weak but received, Binah (Saturn) weak. The Tree of Life coloured by his planets' essential dignity (ibn Ezra's points) What this means for you. Hesed and Gevurah, kindness and strength, are both strong, which the Zohar counts as the right balance of the arms. The centre (Tiferet, balance and truth) and Binah (understanding as structure) are the weak points. Kabbalistically, your work is tikkun of Tiferet: to temper your abundant kindness with the truthful balance of the middle line, so that Hesed does not overflow. The Lurianic phrase for this is hesed she-be-tiferet Interpretation . 7.2 Paths (G2, now complete). Source, corrected In the Gra's tree, Lamed's path runs Hesed–Yesod . In the Ari's (the common Lurianic tree), Lamed runs Hod–Yesod . Round 1 printed "Gevurah–Tiferet", which matches neither, and that is withdrawn. Source, unverified The Gra and Ari placements of Tet (Moon) and Qof (Ascendant) were not found in a text held this round, so they are not stated. Kircher's Christian tree is not used. What this means for you. On both Jewish trees your Sun letter flows into Yesod , the foundation, the sefirah of union and of the covenant. That fits Lamed's faculty (tashmish) exactly. On the Gra's tree it comes from Hesed (kindness) and on the Ari's from Hod (splendour, the scribe's sefirah). Either way, your Sun's path is the channelling of kindness or learning into a faithful bond. 7.3 The 72 Names (Shem ha-Mephorash). Source The names come from Exodus 14:19–21 (three verses of 72 letters each), as in the Bahir and Rashi on Sukkah 45a. The allotment of five degrees to each name is a Renaissance and later convention (two incompatible starting points are in use), so it is not part of classical Jewish astrology. Calculated Starting from 0° Aries: Sun 41 ההה (Hahahel) , Moon 26 האא (Haaiah), Mercury 43 וול (Veuliah), Venus 40 ייז (Ieiazel), Mars 31 לכב (Lecabel), Jupiter 70 יבמ (Jabamiah), Saturn 7 אכא (Achaiah), Ascendant 71 היי (Haiaiel) , MC 54 נית (Nithael). Starting from 0° Leo: Sun 17 לאו, Moon 2 ילי, Ascendant 47 עשל, Jupiter 46 ערי. Five-day calendar allotment (from 21 March): 13 October is day 206, name 42 מיך (Mikael) . The 72 Names, five degrees each from 0° Aries, with his placements What this means for you. The three-letter combinations are meant as meditative keys, not character readings, and nothing classical assigns them a meaning per person. ההה (three Hehs) for the Sun is the breath-letter tripled, which a meditator would take as a call to speech and breath. The five-day name מיך is spelled like Mikha'el , Israel's guardian angel in Daniel 12:1. It is a calendar allotment, not a feature of the chart. 7.4 Gematria of the name and date. Calculated The name has no fixed Hebrew spelling. Primary forms: צ'ארלס ליאונה; alternates לאונה and שארל. The mispar katan 42 of the full primary spelling equals the count of the 42-letter Name (Ana be-Koah), and Charles and Leone each reduce to 21, the value of Ehyeh (אהיה, "I will be"). They are numerical echoes, offered as meditation. Mispar siduri 114 is the number of suras in the Quran and has no Jewish meaning. What the birth month does give, in the Lurianic month cycle, is Tishri's tikkun: the tikkun of judgement (din) sweetened into mercy, and of tashmish, the faculty sanctified in union (Bnei Yissaschar, Tishri discourses Source, unverified ). The Kabbalistic layer repeats the astrological one: strong Hesed, Gevurah and Netzah, weak Tiferet and Binah. The 72-Name and gematria layers give meditation keys and coincidences, not evidence.

docs.h: 8. How this school sees your body
docs.t: Rules: only this school's texts, each trait quoted from the edition checked this round (Reshit Hokhmah, Levy–Cantera English, chapters on Pisces and Jupiter), unstated traits left unspecified, and illness passages omitted under the book's rule. Character in the same passage: "He will indulge freely in sleeping, gluttony, and inebriety. He will not be peremptory, but he will be irascible, polite, deceitful." - Pisces, third face (his Ascendant at 20°39' is in it): "He who is born in the third face will be auburn , and will have beautiful eyes ." - Jupiter (rising, in its own sign): "if it is east, it prognosticates an attractive stature, a body of a white, reddish appearance, little hair, and beautiful eyes … If it is west, his body will be erect… and the hair on his head will be just the opposite of curly , for he will be bald… Generally it results in an individual of noble mind, splendid ambition, excellent vision, attractive beard, and light hair ." - Pisces in the sign–body list: "Its anatomical part comprises the feet and toes." Calculated Jupiter is on the eastern horizon (rising, azimuth 96°) but, by solar phase, 131° ahead of the Sun in longitude, an evening (western) position. Both of ibn Ezra's Jupiter readings therefore apply in part, and they agree on the trait that matters for the portrait: little hair, not curly . The character lines in the same Pisces passage are honest in both directions: polite and not domineering, but prone to irritability, to indulgence in sleep, food and drink, and to evasiveness. Synthesis §8. The verified type is the fair, auburn, dark-eyed, medium-built Pisces with a rising Jupiter. Round 1's "hair unspecified" and its curly-haired portrait are corrected.

docs.h: 10. PROPHECY TEST: every prophesied figure of the Jewish tradition
docs.t: Method. Persian-Arabic astrology runs from Sasanian court astrology (Pahlavi translations of Dorotheus and Vettius Valens, the Zij-i Shahriyar , the Zoroastrian millennial scheme) into Abbasid Baghdad. There, Masha'allah (d. c. 815), Sahl ibn Bishr, 'Umar al-Tabari, Abu Ma'shar (787–886), al-Qabisi (10th c.) and al-Biruni ( Kitab al-Tafhim , 1029) gave the art its classic shape. Its signature tools are reception and the strict rules of 'application', the many lots ( sihām ), the firdaria, the tasyir (directing through the bounds), the doctrine of Saturn–Jupiter conjunctions, and the 28 lunar mansions ( manāzil al-qamar ). Next to it sit letter-science ( 'ilm al-ḥurūf , abjad) and the end-times literature of hadith, Shi'i ghayba works and the Pahlavi apocalypses. Sources I checked online this round: Abu Dawud 4282–4286, Muslim 2937, Muslim 156 and Ibn Majah 4082 (graded Da'if) on sunnah.com; al-Biruni's lots in the Ramsay Wright translation (skyscript.co.uk/alparts.html); the IMO meteor-shower calendar. Other citations are marked Source, verify .

Your appearance here comes only from this tradition's physiognomy: the Ascendant sign, its lord and the planets on it, with the Moon's mansion for the face. All figures are imagined; no real person's likeness is used. Symbolic-body figures The tradition's melothesia ( the body as a map of the sky ) was missing from this chapter. It is added here as a fix. Each zodiac sign governs a body region, from al-Hamal (Aries) at the head down to al-Hut (Pisces) at the feet. Each planet governs organs: the Sun the heart, the Moon the stomach and brain, Mercury the tongue, Venus the liver and kidneys, Mars the gall and kidneys, Jupiter the lungs and liver, and Saturn the spleen, bones and ear. Sources: al-Biruni, Kitab al-Tafhim (on the signs' and planets' parts of the body); Abu Ma'shar, Kitab al-Mudkhal al-Kabir Source, verify exact sections . The verdicts below are this chapter's own. Figure 26: The burj body. Your planets sit on the sign-regions they occupy. Leo (heart) holds the cancelled Moon. Virgo (belly) holds the reversed-strong Mars. Libra (loins) holds the Sun and Venus, both strong-in-shadow. Scorpio (groin) holds Mercury. Pisces (feet) holds the rising Jupiter. What this means for you: your weight sits low and inward, in the loins, groin and feet. Strength comes through partnership (Libra, 8th house) and through a rising Jupiter that grounds you, not through the heart or head. Figure 27: The planetary organ-body (al-Biruni Source, verify ). The medallions float near the organs rather than sitting exactly on them, and the numbered labels give the correct mapping. What this means for you: the lungs and breath (Jupiter, STRONG) are your best-protected system. The stomach (Moon, CANCELLED) and the spleen and bones (Saturn, WEAK) are the places to look after. Figure 28: The mansions on your body. Your planets' lunar mansions are shown as the parts they are named after: al-Jabha "the Forehead" (Moon), al-Iklil "the Crown" (Mercury), al-Zubana "the Claws" (Sun and Venus), Batn al-Hut "the Belly of the Fish" (Ascendant and Jupiter), al-Thurayya (Saturn) and al-Sarfa "the Turning" (Mars). What this means for you: you hold your chart's light in your hands (the Claws) and in your gut (the Fish's Belly). What you grasp and what you digest are where you show your gifts.

Interpretation Your chart is ruled from the horizon by a dignified Jupiter and, over the whole nativity, by Venus. It is a chart of a fair-minded, believing, sociable person whose strength works partly in shadow. Both Libra planets sit in the 8th by whole sign, yet are angular by quadrant. The engine is the Mercury–Mars reception: thought turned into action, and speech with force. Saturn is the only planet with no real rescue. It asks for slow, solitary discipline, and the era-change conjunction of 2020 hit it exactly. The lots set fortune among friends (11th), spirit and faith at the roots (4th), and the knowledge lot on the MC. The prophecy channels echo justice, the rising one, and Khidr's hidden knowledge. Their place and lineage markers stay unmet. Take them as a portrait of virtues to grow into, not a role to claim.

Labels: Calculated = computed here; Source, verify = drawn from the published cuneiform corpus, checked online but worth re-checking against the editions; Interpretation = this book's reading. Babylonian astrology began as the heavens read as a tablet. The gods "wrote" in the sky, and scribes (ṭupšarru) read the signs as omens for the king and the land. Only in the last five centuries BCE did those omens turn into personal horoscopes. This chapter reads your birth the way a scribe of Uruk or Babylon could have: by planet, star, Moon, number, and omen. It finishes with the prophetic texts about "a king who will arise".
