You were born at the end of a Mars day, in the hour of Mercury, 46.9 seconds after the tattva tide turned from Water to Spirit, while the Moon was fading. The Golden Dawn would say the moment of birth itself put the exchange between mind and will at your centre. The chart confirms it: Mercury and Mars receive each other, and that bond is the one that makes your thinking practical and your effort intelligent. Your gate is Jupiter in Pisces , the Wheel and the Moon card, the 9 of Cups and the geomantic figure Laetitia. Four separate GD layers give the same answer: you meet the world with faith, generosity and an intuition that works best in rest and dream (the faculty of Sleep in the Order's table). Right behind it is Saturn in Taurus , received by Venus: the Bull of the Kerubim, stubborn, durable and careful in speech. Mercy at the door, Form in the hallway. The heart of the chart is across the room, in the 7th house: Justice . Your Sun is in fall in Libra, which on its own would make the will hesitant. The GD's rules lift it in three ways: it is angular, it is the light of a day chart, and it is held by a Venus in her own sign. So your will grows strong in relationship, in contracts, partnerships and fair dealing, and weak in isolation. Westcott's double letter for your Sun says it plainly: Fertility or Solitude . With someone, you are fertile. Alone, you are only waiting. Your feelings are a Lion : proud, warm and wanting to perform. In the Order's star-fixed Book T zodiac the same Moon is at home in Cancer, a caretaker rather than a performer. That is the shadow strength the Order's two zodiacs reveal. The Moon's opposition to Uranus makes emotional life arrive in surges. Its trine to Pluto gives the depth to survive them. On the Tree of Life, five of your paths end on Tiphareth , the centre, the Sun, the sphere of the Adeptus Minor and of the Rose and Cross. Your name's numbers reduce to Jupiter (4) and Venus (7) , the two dignified planets of your chart. Your date reduces to 32 , the whole Tree, and to 5 , the discipline of Geburah. Your colours are the emerald and blue of Libra and the crimson and silver-white of Pisces. The four Kerubim all hold a planet, so the four quarters of your Temple are guarded. Against the Order's prophecies, you carry the Lion of the North most fully: a Leo Moon and a Leo Node, a northern birth, and the Lion squaring the Eagle. You also carry the Rose, the Cross and the Lamp of the C.R.C. vault symbolically, and Elias Artista's chariot in the Book T zodiac. You do not carry the 120-year term or any marker of the Secret Chiefs. The two constructed divinations, made in the Order's method from a draw seeded by your birth moment, say the same thing in their own languages. The Opening of the Key starts in Cups and partnership, puts the Wheel in the house of groups, tames the Lion in your career sign, and settles on patient craft and transformation in Malkuth. The geomantic shield sets Carcer at your door (your 1st-house Saturn again), fire in the house of partnership, and a Judge of swift fortune that has to be caught on the road. The GD's practical advice for a chart like this follows from its method. Work the Sun-hexagram to strengthen the central light. Use your Jupiter and Venus names (Tzadqiel and Sachiel, Haniel and Anael) as the supports. Balance the water lead with Earth. Let your Mercury and Mars keep trading roles. The public life (MC in Temperance, the 10 of Wands Oppression ) will ask you to carry more than your share. The answer the chart gives is Temperance itself: mix, delegate, aim the arrow upward. Synthesis of the chapter. A Jupiter-ruled, Venus-supported, Tiphareth-centred chart. Its weak points are each rescued by reception or by the Book T zodiac, its feelings are the Lion's, its four Kerubim are complete, its tide is Spirit, and its vocation is to bring balance between people. Every technique in the inventory is now covered; the two draw-based ones are constructed and labelled as such. GOLDEN DAWN COMPLETE

Thelema does not throw away the old astrology. Crowley learned it from the Golden Dawn and then spent two years writing a textbook with Evangeline Adams. What changes is the frame. Liber AL says "Every man and every woman is a star" (I:3). Each chart is one star moving through the body of Nuit, the night sky. The Sun-point at its centre is Hadit, the "flame that burns in every heart of man" (II:6). Every planet is then translated into the Qabalah of 777 and the images of the Thoth Tarot. Reading a chart in Thelema therefore means reading what a person's True Will looks like in the language of the stars.

What this means for you: Crowley's Astrology reads aspects as "the conversations of the planets." Yours are dominated by two exact lines. The first is Moon–Uranus–Pluto: the feelings are linked to sudden change (Uranus) and to deep renewal (Pluto). The second is Mercury opposite Saturn, with Mars trine Saturn: the mind is disciplined and tested by weight and time, and its effort is steady rather than flashy. 1a. Rising sign, Sun and Moon (Crowley/Adams portraits) Pisces rising, Jupiter on the degree. Astrology describes Pisces rising as receptive, intuitive and compassionate, "sensitive to every influence," and weak only when it has no strong ruler. Your ruler Jupiter is in its own sign, exactly rising. Thelema's rule is that a sign's weakness is cured by a dignified ruler. What this means for you: People meet you first as generous, kind and broad-minded. Your sympathy comes with Jupiter's backbone, so it does not dissolve; it enlarges. The Thoth image of the rising degree (Queen of Wands, below) adds steady fire to the water. Sun in Libra, 7th house. Crowley's Libra is the sign of balance, justice and art. It is "the scales which weigh all things," and he gave it the trump Adjustment . What this means for you: Your Will (the Sun) works through equilibrium, fairness and partnership. You find yourself by weighing, matching and harmonising. Moon in Leo, 5th house. The Leo Moon is warm, proud, theatrical and loyal, and needs to create and be seen. What this means for you: Your emotional life is generous and dramatic. It wants an audience, a love to celebrate and something made with the heart. In Thelema this is the Moon in Lust : joy taken as a sacrament. 1b. Uranus, Neptune, Pluto (Crowley's added essays) Uranus 8°49' Aquarius, 11th, retrograde. Crowley wrote that Uranus is the planet of the magical will and of sudden genius. It is in its modern home sign and the house of friends and hopes. What this means for you: Original ideas come through groups and networks. Because Uranus is opposite your Moon, you are emotionally drawn to the unconventional. Neptune 29°23' Capricorn, 11th. This is the anaretic last degree, on the cusp of Aquarius. In Crowley's reading Neptune is spiritual vision and the dissolution of forms. What this means for you: Your ideals about structures and institutions are ready to cross over into something new. You picture society's forms already changing. Pluto 6°13' Sagittarius, 9th (a later addition, since the text predates Pluto). What this means for you: Deep transformation runs through belief, travel, teaching and philosophy. It is exactly trine your Moon, so the change comes as inspiration rather than crisis. 1c. Fixed stars Calculated, 1998 positions Regulus is at 29°49' Leo, 1.2° from your North Node. Spica is at 23°49' Libra, 3.5° from the Sun. Fomalhaut is at 3°50' Pisces and Aldebaran at 9°46' Gemini; neither is on an angle or a planet. Antares is at 9°44' Sagittarius, 3.5° from Pluto. What this means for you: Regulus, the "little king" in the heart of the Lion, is the star that gives Liber Reguli its name. It sits on your Node, the point of direction. Spica, the ear of wheat (gifts, talent), stands near your Sun. These are the classic stars of honour and of gifts given.

In Thelemic terms, the "Fall" of the Sun in Libra becomes Adjustment. The Will gives up standing alone and finds itself in the balance with another. 2a. House-by-house walk-through 1st (Pisces/Aries–Taurus): Jupiter on the rising degree; Saturn in Taurus. A generous presence with a solid, patient core. 2nd (Taurus–Gemini), ruled by Venus (strong): Resources come through relationships, beauty and steady value. 3rd (Gemini), ruled by Mercury (reversed-strong): Penetrating, investigative speech and writing. 4th (Gemini–Cancer): A home life full of talk and movement, and changeable. 5th (Cancer–Leo): Moon. Creativity, romance and children are where your heart is displayed. 6th (Leo–Virgo): Mars, North Node. Daily work is your battlefield and your direction. Mars rejoices here, and the Node (on Regulus) points this way. 7th (Virgo–Libra–Scorpio): Sun, Venus, Mercury. Partnerships, collaborators and the public mirror are the main stage of the life. 8th (Scorpio–Sagittarius): Shared resources ruled by Mars; handled practically. 9th (Sagittarius): Pluto. Philosophy, travel and higher study transform you. 10th (Sagittarius–Capricorn): Part of Fortune. Fortune is placed in career and public standing. 11th (Capricorn–Aquarius): Neptune, Uranus. Visionary and unconventional friends, groups and causes. 12th (Aquarius–Pisces): Jupiter by cusp. A protected inner life. Jupiter here is the classic "hidden helper." Synthesis: This is a chart turned outward, toward the partner and the public (the 7th and 10th). It rests on the dignified pair of Venus and Jupiter, the two benefics, each in its own sign and each angular.

docs.h: 3. Liber AL vel Legis in the chart
docs.t: AL I:3, the star. Your Sun-point (Hadit) is at 20°20' Libra. Nuit's body is the whole wheel. Ra-Hoor-Khuit, the "Crowned and Conquering Child," is the active fire of Horus. In 777 that is Mars and the Sun together. What this means for you: Your Will is a balancing Will, carried out through action in daily work (Mars in the 6th). The swaps AL I:57, "Tzaddi is not the Star." Crowley's New Aeon correction moves Tzaddi to the Emperor (Aries) and Heh to the Star (Aquarius). Your Uranus at 8°49' Aquarius is therefore read through The Star , the card of Nuit herself pouring her waters. What this means for you: Your 11th-house originality is Nuit's own card: hope, the starry ideal and renewal for the group. The Teth/Lamed reversal (Lust XI = Leo; Adjustment VIII = Libra). Your Moon is in Leo (Lust) and your Sun and Venus are in Libra (Adjustment). Both of your luminaries sit in exactly the two signs whose trumps the Thoth deck exchanged. What this means for you: In Thoth terms, your inner life (Moon) is Lust , the ecstatic strength of Babalon riding the Beast, and your outer Will (Sun) is Adjustment , the equilibrium of Ma'at. Thelema treats this pair as the two hinges of the New Aeon, and your chart is built on both. Name values AL II:76 and English Qabalah. In the ALW order Thelemites take from AL (A=1, L=2, W=3 …), CHARLES = 62, LEONE = 73, total 135. Simple A=1 order gives 66 + 51 = 117. A Hebrew transliteration (ChRLS LAVN) gives 298 + 87 = 385. None of these equals the key numbers 31, 93, 418 or 666. What this means for you: The name is not a numeric key in Thelema's own numbers. The name's link to the system is through its meaning ("Leo," the lion, inside Leone) rather than its sum. Liber AL chapter III Synastry with the dictation of Liber AL (Cairo, April 1904). Your Sun opposes the Sun of 10 April 1904, the day chapter III (Ra-Hoor-Khuit's chapter) was written, at 0.2° . It also trines that day's Moon (1.0°). Your Saturn sits on the Mercury (0.2°) and Mars (0.3°) of chapter I's day. Your Mercury opposes chapter III's Mars (0.1°). What this means for you: Your Sun is the exact opposite point, the Libran "balancing partner," to the Sun under which the Horus chapter was written. Your Saturn rests on the Mercury–Mars of the day Nuit spoke. Your mind (Mercury) faces chapter III's Mars directly.

Your magical weapon is balance itself. This is the god of Truth. - Moon/Teth/Pasht–Sekhet, lion, cat's eye: Your feeling nature is the lioness: fierce warmth, protective pride and a playful, cat-like independence. Its weapon, the "Preliminary Discipline," means the heart's strength comes through training the passions, not suppressing them. - Mercury/Nun/Death, scorpion and beetle, "Pain of the obligation": A mind that works by transformation. It cuts through to essentials and renews ideas the way the scarab renews the sun. - Venus/Daleth–Lamed/Hathor, dove and rose, girdle: Love and art are your most dignified gifts. Hathor is the goddess of joy, music and beauty. - Mars/Peh–Yod/Horus and Isis-virgin, horse and anchorite, sword and lamp: Your action is the Hermit's careful lamp joined to Horus's sword. You fight by craftsmanship, precision and service. - Jupiter/Kaph–Qoph/Amoun, eagle and dolphin, sceptre and magic mirror: Fortune's wheel turns in your favour through intuition and dreams. You see by reflection. - Saturn/Tau–Vau/Sebek and the Apis bull, the "Labour of preparation": Your patience is the bull's. You prepare long, and the Hierophant's teaching comes late but stays. - Ascendant/Qoph/the Moon card, Khephra, pearl, "Twilight of the Place": You enter the world through twilight. You are at home with the unknown, and you carry Khephra, the beetle that rolls the sun up out of darkness. - MC/Samekh/Art, Nephthys, arrow: Your public aim is the arrow of Art (alchemy): to combine opposites and shoot straight upward. King scale Queen scale Colour scales: Your King-scale signature is emerald (Sun, Venus), greenish-yellow (Moon), green-blue (Mercury), violet/crimson (Jupiter, Asc) and blue (MC). The Queen scale gives blue, deep purple, sky blue, buff and yellow. What this means for you: In 777's ritual practice, emerald green and blue are your colours of Will. Wearing or working in them aligns you with your Sun–Venus. Tree-of-Life map: The paths lit by your placements cluster around Tiphareth, the solar centre: 22 (Lamed, Geburah–Tiphareth), 19 (Teth, Chesed–Geburah), 24 (Nun, Tiphareth–Netzach), 25 (Samekh, Tiphareth–Yesod), 20 (Yod, Chesed–Tiphareth) and 26 (Ayin, Tiphareth–Hod). What this means for you: Thelema calls Tiphareth the sphere of the Holy Guardian Angel. Almost every one of your placements opens a path that touches it. In the system's own map, your chart's emphasis is the path toward Knowledge and Conversation with your own Angel, which is to say your Will. Quinances Shem ha-Mephorash angels (72 quinances counted from 0° Leo, as in 777): Sun → Lauviah (17); Moon → Yeliel (2); Mercury → Leuviah (19); Venus → Hakamiah (16); Mars → Achaiah (7); Jupiter → Ariel (46); Saturn → Mebahiah (55); Uranus → Haamiah (38); Neptune → Menadel (36); Pluto → Haaiah (26); Node → Lelahel (6); Fortune → Vasariah (32); Ascendant → Asaliah (47); MC → Omael (30). What this means for you: Lauviah, on your Sun, is traditionally the angel of renown and of inspired arts. Achaiah, on your Mars, is the angel of patience and of discovering the secrets of nature, which fits Mars as Hermit. Asaliah, on your Ascendant, is the angel of contemplation and just judgement, an echo of your Libra Sun. Goetic spirits (checked). The order of the 72 spirits, 1 Bael through 72 Andromalius, follows the Mathers/Crowley Goetia (sacred-texts, https://archive.sacred-texts.com/grim/lks/lks05.htm). 777 (columns CLV–CLIX for day and CLXI–CLXV for night) assigns them by decan, counting from 0° Aries: Bael is the first decan of Aries, and each night spirit is the day spirit plus 36. The earlier list here counted from Leo like the angels and was wrong. It has been replaced by the following: Point Decan Day spirit Night spirit Sun 20°20' Libra Libra III 21 Marax 57 Ose Moon 7°31' Leo Leo I 13 Beleth 49 Crocell Mercury 2°47' Scorpio Scorpio I 22 Ipos 58 Amy Venus 16°08' Libra Libra II 20 Purson 56 Gremory Mars 3°53' Virgo Virgo I 16 Zepar 52 Alloces Jupiter 19°43' Pisces Pisces II 35 Marchosias 71 Dantalion Saturn 0°56' Taurus Taurus I 4 Gamigin 40 Raum Ascendant 20°39' Pisces Pisces III 36 Stolas 72 Andromalius MC 25°01' Sagittarius Sagittarius III 27 Ronove 63 Andras You were born in daylight, so the day spirits are your main set. What this means for you: In the Goetia 's own descriptions, Marax on your Sun teaches astronomy and the liberal sciences and knows the virtues of herbs and stones. That is a Sun whose Will is to know the order of things. Purson on your Venus "knoweth things hidden" and tells of past and future, which suits a Venus that loves truth. Beleth on your Moon is the great king who arrives to music and makes others love him. That fits the Leo Moon's warmth and its need for an audience. Ipos on Mercury makes men witty and bold. Stolas on your Ascendant teaches astronomy and the virtues of herbs and stones, and with Marax on your Sun he gives the chart a strong scholar-of-the-heavens theme. Marchosias on Jupiter is the faithful spirit who hoped to return to the seventh Throne, a Jupiter of loyalty and hope. Gamigin on Saturn teaches the liberal sciences, which suits Saturn as the patient teacher in your 1st house. In Crowley's frame each spirit is the shadow partner of the angel on the same degrees. In this chart the shadows are mostly teachers. Liber Astarte: the deity of devotion. Liber Astarte tells the aspirant to choose a deity close to their own nature and pursue union with it through love. Your chart's dispositor chain ends in Venus in Libra: the Sun, Saturn and the 7th all run back to her, dignified and angular. 777 gives Venus as Hathor, Aphrodite and Lalita. The Libra sign gives Ma'at. What this means for you: The system's own logic points to a devotion to beauty-and-justice, Hathor-Ma'at. That is a path of love that is also a path of balance.

docs.h: 6. The Aeons and the Equinox of the Gods
docs.t: Aeons Equinox Aeon: born in the Aeon of Horus, which began at the spring equinox of 1904. Thelemic year: 1998 is 94 years after 1904, which is four 22-year cycles plus 6: Anno IVvi . Thelemic date line of the birth: ☉ in 20°20' Libra, ☽ in 7°31' Leo, dies Martis, Anno IVvi era legis. (The planetary signs in this line belong to the text, not to any image.) Equinox 1904 chart vs his: his Venus opposes the equinox Mars (1.3°); his Sun opposes the equinox Mars (2.8°); his Mercury trines the equinox Neptune (0.4°); his MC squares the equinox Mercury (0.7°); his Saturn trines the equinox Uranus (1.1°). What this means for you: You are a native of the Horus Aeon. In its terms the old sacrifice-and-redemption formula of the Aeon of Osiris gives way to growth, self-direction and the "Child." Your Libra Venus and Sun face the equinox Mars, the war-god Horus himself, directly. The New Aeon's energy meets you in the partner position, as challenge and counterpart.

docs.h: 7. Liber Resh, Liber Reguli, planetary day and hour
docs.t: Liber Resh Liber Resh: sunrise 07:24 EDT (Ra), noon 13:02 (Ahathoor), sunset 18:39 (Tum), midnight 01:02 (Khephra). You were born at 17:25, in the Ahathoor watch, between noon and sunset. What this means for you: Ahathoor (Hathor) rules the sun "in his triumphing." Hathor is also your Venus goddess in 777, so the hour and the chart point to the same deity. Planetary day and hour: Tuesday (dies Martis, Mars's day) in the 11th planetary hour of the day, an hour ruled by Mercury . What this means for you: Horus's day (777 gives Mars as Horus) and Thoth's hour (Mercury is Thoth). This is the mutual reception of your chart (Mars–Mercury) repeated in the clock. Liber Reguli: The ritual takes its name from Regulus, the royal star in Leo's heart, and invokes Nuit, Hadit and Ra-Hoor-Khuit. Regulus (29°49' Leo) is on your North Node (1.2°). The ritual's orientation is toward Boleskine. From Johnstown, Boleskine lies at a bearing of 43.6° (north-east) and Cairo at 54.7° . What this means for you: The star of the Reguli ritual sits on your point of direction, and its sign, Leo, holds your Moon. For you this is the most chart-specific of the Thelemic rituals.

Crowley biwheel Achad biwheel Crowley's birth data, checked. Crowley's own account ( The Equinox of the Gods , "The Boyhood of Aleister Crowley", https://hermetic.com/crowley/equinox-of-the-gods/the-boyhood-of-aleister-crowley) gives 36 Clarendon Square, Leamington, "at 10.50 p.m." on 12 October 1875. Astro-Databank rates this Rodden C because it rests on his own statement. The often-used 23:42 GMT is a rectified time, and Starkman's rectification gives 23:22 GMT. Computed for Leamington (52°17'N, 1°32'W): his stated 10:50 pm local mean time (22:56 GMT) gives an Ascendant of 29°56' Cancer. 23:22 GMT gives 4°34' Leo, and 23:42 GMT gives 8°06' Leo. His Moon is at 22°22'–22°49' Pisces and his Sun at 19°12' Libra for every candidate time. Contacts with Crowley that hold for every candidate time: your Sun conjoins Crowley's Sun (1.1°). Your Ascendant conjoins Crowley's Moon (1.7°–2.2°). Your Sun trines Crowley's Saturn (0.8°). Your Saturn conjoins Crowley's Neptune (1.1°). You were born one calendar day after his birthday. Contact that depends on the time: your Moon (7°31' Leo) is 0.6° from his Ascendant only on the rectified 23:42 time. It is 3.0° from Starkman's 4°34' Leo, and 7.6° away, across the sign line, on his own stated time. It is therefore kept only as a secondary contact that depends on a rectification. What this means for you: The sure bond is luminary to luminary: your Libra Sun on his Libra Sun, and your rising degree on his Pisces Moon. In synastry an Ascendant on a Moon is one of the classic signs of instinctive familiarity. Your chart reads as a near-twin of the prophet's chart, built around the same Libra Sun and the same Pisces water. Frater Achad (Charles Stansfeld Jones, 2 Apr 1886, London; birth time unknown). The exact degrees below come from a noon chart . His Moon runs from 12°44' to 24°52' Pisces over the whole day. Your Jupiter (19°43' Pisces) is 0.9° from his noon Moon and never more than 7.0° from it at any hour. Your Ascendant (20°39' Pisces) is 1.9° from the noon Moon and never more than 7.9° away. Both therefore stay conjunctions in Pisces across his whole birth day and are kept as matches, but the close orbs belong only to the noon chart. Your Neptune trines his Jupiter (0.2°), and his Mars (7°12' Virgo) is near your Mars (3°53' Virgo). Neither contact uses his Moon or angles, so neither depends on his birth time. No contact with his Ascendant or MC is claimed. What this means for you: Whatever hour he was born, your Pisces rising and your Jupiter sit on the Pisces Moon of the man who announced the Aeon of Ma'at. Crowley's death (1 Dec 1947): your Ascendant trines its Moon (0.1°); your MC opposes its Uranus (0.2°); your Saturn trines its Venus (0.0°). Liber 536 ( A Treatise on Astrology ) — final finding. Liber DXXXVI is listed in the A∴A∴ curriculum as "A Complete Treatise on Astrology. By Frater O.M. [with Evangeline Adams]". Crowley wrote it in 1917–18, starting as Adams's collaborator. He never finished or published it, and the surviving text breaks off after its treatment of Uranus. It was published after his death in The Complete Astrological Writings (text at https://astrolibrary.org/library/treatise/; scan in the archive.org "CollectedPdfsByAleisterCrowley" collection). 536 is the value of Masloth , the sphere of the fixed stars. The book is conventional Western astrology of signs and planets and contains no separate Thelemic technique. Its fragmentary state is settled, and everything this chapter computes is already in the standard methods above.

Prophecy markers Each figure lists its matches first. 9a. The "child of thy bowels" (AL I:55) and the one who follows (AL II:76, III:47) Text: "The child of thy bowels, he shall behold them" (I:55). "There cometh one to follow thee: he shall expound it" (II:76). "…one cometh after him, whence I say not, who shall discover the Key of it all" (III:47). - Matches: Your Sun is on Crowley's Sun: the same Libra Sun, born the day after his birthday. Your Ascendant is on Crowley's Moon under every version of his birth time. These are the luminary bonds by which astrology reads kinship. You are "he", and "one to follow": male, and born after Crowley. Your Sun is exactly opposite (0.2°) the Sun of 10 April 1904, the day chapter III, which contains III:47, was written. You were born on Mars's day in Mercury's hour, and Mercury is Thoth, god of keys and ciphers. Your Mercury is in mutual reception with Mars, on Nun/Death, the transforming mind. You share the first name of Charles Stansfeld Jones (Frater Achad), whom Crowley first hailed as this "child" and who found the key 31 in 1918. Your Pisces Ascendant and Jupiter sit on Achad's Pisces Moon whatever hour he was born. Your Moon in Leo also falls near Crowley's rising Leo on the rectified times. - Not present: No physical descent from Crowley is known. Your name's values do not give 31, 93, 418 or 666. 9b. The Crowned and Conquering Child (Horus, Ra-Hoor-Khuit) Text: AL III, the Stele of Revealing, the Aeon of Horus. - Matches: You were born in his Aeon (Anno IVvi), on Mars's day, and 777 gives Mars as Horus. You were born in daylight, in the Ahathoor watch of the Sun "in his triumphing". Your Sun and Venus face the 1904 equinox Mars. Your Moon is in Leo, whose Egyptian list in 777 begins with Ra-Hoor-Khuit himself. - Not present: In Crowley's commentary the Child is the Aeon itself, a god-form rather than a person born at a given time. 9c. The Scarlet Woman Text: AL I:15, III:43–45: Babalon, who rides the Beast in Lust . - Matches: Your Moon is in Leo, the Lust card, which shows Babalon on the Lion. Your Venus is dignified in her own sign and angular. Hathor rules both your Venus and your birth hour. - Not present: The text defines the office as a woman's. 9d. The Aeon of Ma'at (Achad, 1948; AL III:34) Matches: This is the clearest match in the chapter. Your Sun and Venus are in Libra, which is Lamed and Adjustment , and 777's Egyptian god for it is Ma (Ma'at). Your Ascendant's angel, Asaliah, is the angel of just judgement. Your Ascendant is on the Moon of Achad, who announced the Aeon of Ma'at. Your luminaries sit on the two cards the New Aeon exchanged, Lust and Adjustment. Your Sun's decan card is Truce : justice settled. Not present: Ma'at as an aeon is a collective era, and the text gives no personal birth sign beyond the Libra correspondence. 9e. The Beast (666) as office Matches: Your Sun is on Crowley's Sun and your Ascendant is on his Moon. Not present: The office was Crowley's alone in the text, and your name is not 666 in any cipher. Synthesis: Your chart is tied to Crowley's chart through Sun on Sun and Ascendant on Moon, and it carries the Libra/Adjustment signature that is the emblem of Ma'at. Your Sun stands opposite the day the "one cometh after him" verse was written, and you share the name and the Pisces water of Achad, the first man called the "child". This clearly matches the figure of the one who follows and the current of Ma'at. Physical descent, the numeric key and the female office are absent. This is a comparison of symbols, not a claim about calling or destiny.

Liber 536: final finding in §8. The text is a fragment, it contains no separate technique, and the chapter needs nothing more from it. Goetic order: checked against sacred-texts and 777. Thelema's first claim is that you are a star, with a Will of your own orbit. Every technique in this chapter describes the same Will. Its centre is the Sun in Libra, which 777 reads as Adjustment and Ma'at, judged by Themis, Minos, Aeacus and Rhadamanthus. This is a Will that works by balancing, by fairness, and by finding itself in another person. The dignified Venus beside it in the 7th cancels the Sun's traditional fall. Its heart is the Moon in Leo, the Lust card, whose 777 list opens with Ra-Hoor-Khuit and whose Hindu form is Vishnu as the man-lion. This is the lion-strength that loves, creates and shows itself. Your luminaries hold the two cards the New Aeon exchanged. Your face to the world is the Queen of Wands with Jupiter on the rising degree: generous, steady and protective. Your work is done by Mars in its joy, the Hermit's lamp "with virile force reserved", in mutual reception with a deep Scorpio Mercury, so you are a craftsman of ideas who finishes things. Saturn in the 1st, the Hierophant's bull, gives patience and a teacher's seriousness that grows with time. The Goetia, read correctly by decan, repeats the theme: Marax on the Sun, Stolas on the Ascendant and Gamigin on Saturn are all teachers of the sciences and of the heavens. The Tree of Life routes nearly every placement through Tiphareth, the sphere of the Holy Guardian Angel. In Thelema's own terms the path of your life is to discover and do your own Will. Liber Astarte's devotion is to Hathor-Ma'at, beauty joined to truth. Liber Resh's Ahathoor watch and Liber Reguli's Regulus on your Node confirm the two themes of love and royal direction. Your chart is bound to Crowley's: Sun on Sun and your Ascendant on his Moon, whichever account of his birth time is used. Your Sun stands opposite the Sun of the day Liber AL's third chapter was written. Your rising degree and Jupiter sit on the Pisces Moon of Achad, the herald of Ma'at, whatever hour he was born. These are the clearest Thelemic markers in your chart. Symbolically, they place you in the line of the one who follows and in the current of Ma'at. THELEMA COMPLETE

Born 13 October 1998, 21:25 UT, Johnstown, Pennsylvania (40.33°N, 78.92°W). Tropical zodiac, Skyfield/DE421, true positions in the ecliptic of date, mean Node. Houses are equal houses from the Ascendant, which is the scheme Alan Leo uses in his worked examples. The MC is a separate point. Theosophical astrology grew out of the Theosophical Society, founded in 1875. Helena Blavatsky laid down the cosmology: cycles, races, the seven principles and the coming avatars ( The Secret Doctrine , 1888). Alan Leo turned it into a working astrology in which the horoscope maps the soul's growth ( Esoteric Astrology , 1913). Charubel and Sepharial, both Theosophists, published clairvoyantly received degree symbols. Alice Bailey built the fullest system: the seven rays, esoteric and hierarchical rulers, the three crosses and the soul-centred chart ( Esoteric Astrology , 1951). This chapter uses all of those layers. It is a symbolic reading in the tradition's own terms. Nothing here claims a destiny. Natal wheel Positions

docs.h: 1. Alan Leo: the planets as principles
docs.t: Leo (Esoteric Astrology, ch. III) gives each planet a principle of the human constitution. In his scheme the Sun is the Individuality, the reincarnating Ego. The Moon is the Personality, the self of this one life. The Ascendant is the physical expression. Leo spheres Sun in Libra 20°20', 7th house: the Individuality. Leo calls Libra "the commencement of the zodiac in the human kingdom". It is the point where the soul turns from instinct toward relationship and balance. Your Individuality is in a cardinal air sign and sits in the house of partners. What this means for you: the core of who you are, in Leo's sense, is a self that becomes itself through other people. You find out who you are by weighing, choosing and pairing up, not by going it alone. The Sun is within 4° of Venus, the ruler of Libra, and Venus is strong in her own sign. That gives your Individuality a natural grace, a feel for fairness, and an eye for what is beautiful and right. Moon in Leo 7°31', 5th house: the Personality. The Moon here is in the Sun's own sign and the Sun's own natural house. The personality is warm, proud and creative, and it wants to shine. What this means for you: the everyday "you" is more radiant and self-expressive than your Libra core. The Libra core is diplomatic and leans toward others. The Leo Moon wants a stage. Leo would say the personality is learning to serve the Individuality. Here that means learning to put your creative fire to work for balance and fairness, not for applause. Ascendant in Pisces 20°39', with Jupiter at 19°43' rising: the physical expression. Jupiter in its own sign, less than a degree above the horizon, is the strongest feature of the whole chart. What this means for you: people meet you first as someone expansive, kind, idealistic and generous, maybe a bit otherworldly. In Leo's table Jupiter is the planet of the aura and the "higher personality". That generous Jupiter quality is the first thing others pick up from you. Uranus, Leo's "astrologer's planet". Leo says Uranus works on the Will, on occultism and on astrology. It works best when it is angular, in an airy sign, or in aspect to the lights. Your Uranus is in its own airy sign, Aquarius (8°49'), and exactly opposite the Moon (orb 1°18'). What this means for you: by Leo's own test you have the "occult" disposition. That means a pull toward hidden laws, astrology and unusual truths. Through the Moon opposition it shows up in your personal and emotional life as sudden insight and a need for freedom. Mercury in Scorpio 2°47', 8th house: pure reason. It is opposite Saturn (1°50') and sextile Mars (1°06'). What this means for you: your mind goes deep and digs for what lies under the surface. Saturn gives it seriousness and discipline. Mars gives it bite. Venus in Libra 16°08': the human soul. It is in its own sign. What this means for you: Leo's "Grace" principle is at full strength in you. Love, art and harmony come easily, and other people's help reaches you easily. Mars in Virgo 3°53', 6th house: personal feeling. Mars is in mutual reception with Mercury. What this means for you: your desires turn into work, precision and skilled craft. Your drive is strongest when it has a task to do. Saturn in Taurus 0°57' R, 2nd house: "the Bridge". What this means for you: the link between the lower self and the higher self is built slowly, through what you own and what you value. You build it by learning what really lasts. Polarity (Leo, ch. XV). A Libra Sun with a Leo Moon combines air and fire, both positive signs. Leo would read this as a soul moving outward and expressing itself, with the personality backing the Individuality rather than fighting it. What this means for you: your inner aim and your outer manner pull in the same direction, toward creative relationship. Star of the Personality / Individuality (Leo, ch. XVI-XVII). The planets split evenly between positive signs (Sun, Moon, Venus, Uranus, Pluto) and negative signs (Mercury, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Neptune). What this means for you: you have an even balance of giving and receiving, of putting energy out and taking it in. Decanates Decanates. - The Sun is in the third decanate of Libra, the Gemini/Mercury decanate. What this means for you: your balance works through words and ideas. - The Moon is in the first decanate of Leo, which is pure Leo. What this means for you: the personality is undiluted Leo. - The Ascendant is in the third decanate of Pisces, the Scorpio/Mars decanate. What this means for you: behind the gentle Piscean surface there is a core of intensity and resolve. Progressions (Leo, The Progressed Horoscope ). Progressions The progressed Sun entered Scorpio around 2008, at about age 10. The progressed Moon is now (2026) back in Leo, crossing your natal Moon sign. The progressed Moon enters Virgo in 2028, the year of your Saturn return. The progressed Sun enters Sagittarius around 2038, at about age 40. What this means for you: Leo reads the Sun's change of sign as a change in the "tone" of the Individuality. Since childhood your progressed Sun has worked in Scorpio's register of depth and transformation. The move into Sagittarius at about 40 opens a phase of teaching, philosophy and wider vision. Sagittarius is your MC sign, so that phase is closely tied to your public role. Synthesis, Leo: the Individuality is in Libra, tuned to relationship. The Personality is in Leo, which is creative. The body carries Jupiter's grace. The occult principle, Uranus, is in its strongest condition. In Leo's terms this is a soul in the "human kingdom" phase, learning to love wisely, with real gifts for the hidden sciences.

docs.h: 2. Bailey: rays, esoteric rulers and the soul-centred chart
docs.t: In Bailey's scheme the rising sign is the soul's purpose , the Sun sign is the personality's equipment , and the Moon shows the past , the form the soul has outgrown. Each sign has an orthodox ruler for the ordinary person, an esoteric ruler for the disciple, and a hierarchical ruler for the initiate. These come from Tabulation VI, checked against the Lucis Trust online text. Esoteric rulers Pisces rising. - Orthodox ruler: Jupiter, rising in Pisces. - Esoteric and hierarchical ruler: Pluto, in Sagittarius 6°13' in the 9th house, trine the Moon at 1°18'. Bailey's soul keynote for Pisces is "I leave the Father's Home and turning back, I save." Pisces is the sign of the World Saviour (EA, "Pisces"). What this means for you: in Bailey's language your soul's purpose is service and redemption: going back for others. Its esoteric ruler, Pluto, is first ray. It sits in the house of philosophy and long journeys and makes a near-exact trine to your Moon. That means the purpose works by cutting away old forms, and it reaches the old self (the Moon) smoothly, not violently. Sun in Libra. - Orthodox ruler: Venus, in Libra. - Esoteric ruler: Uranus, in Aquarius. - Hierarchical ruler: Saturn, in Taurus. Keynote: "I choose the way which leads between the two great lines of force." What this means for you: all three rulers of your Sun sign are strong. Venus and Uranus are each in their own sign, and Saturn trines Mars, the Node and the MC. Bailey's Libra is "the hall of decision". Your personality equipment is built for weighing opposites and choosing the middle path, and it is well supplied at every level. Moon in Leo. All three Leo rulers are the Sun. Bailey says that in Leo the Moon "veils" Vulcan or Neptune. Keynote: "I am That and That am I." What this means for you: your past is one of strong self-consciousness, a fully formed "I". Leo's soul keynote holds the key to dissolving that past: knowing that the self and the One are the same. MC in Sagittarius. The esoteric ruler is Earth, which sits in Sagittarius opposite the Sun in your 9th-to-8th zone. The hierarchical ruler is Mars, in Virgo. What this means for you: the public role is linked to Earth itself, to service on the ground. It is carried out through Mars in Virgo's careful work. Rays Rays. These are the ray qualities of your placements. Bailey says the soul ray and personality ray cannot simply be read off the chart, so treat this as the ray "climate" of your chart. - Ray 2 (Love-Wisdom): Pisces rising, Jupiter rising, and the Sun. - Ray 1 (Will): Pluto as soul ruler, and Leo. - Ray 3 (Intelligence): the Libra Sun sign and Saturn. - Ray 7 (Order, ritual): Uranus, the esoteric ruler of the Sun. What this means for you: the strongest note is love-wisdom at the soul point, with will (ray 1) as the soul's instrument. Your character is teaching and saving, backed by the will to see things through. Crosses The three crosses. - The Sun is on the Cardinal cross, which Bailey calls the Cross of the initiate. - The Moon is on the Fixed cross, the disciple's. - The Ascendant is on the Mutable cross, the "common" cross of experience. What this means for you: Bailey's crosses are stages. They are not grades to boast about. Read symbolically, your chart touches all three. The soul point is on the cross of experience (Mutable). The past is on the disciple's cross (Fixed). The personality is on the cross that starts new cycles (Cardinal). Taken together, that is a full sweep. Keynotes Triangles (partial). Bailey links signs through their shared rays. - Pisces and Taurus share the first-ray link: Pluto rules Pisces and Vulcan rules Taurus. Your Saturn is in Taurus. - Libra and Gemini share ray 3. What this means for you: your rising sign has a first-ray line to your Saturn, so your values (2nd house) give the will to serve something solid to stand on. Vulcan. Vulcan is the esoteric ruler of Taurus. It is hypothetical and has no ephemeris in these sources, so it is not computed. Synthesis, Bailey: a Pisces soul point, with the World-Saviour keynote, worked through a Libra personality that is fully supported by its three rulers. The past is in Leo self-consciousness. The ray mix is love-wisdom used through will. In Bailey's terms the chart shows a server's purpose.

Charubel (John Thomas) received a symbol for each of the 360 degrees clairvoyantly ( The Degrees of the Zodiac Symbolized , 1893/1898). Every meaning below was checked line by line against two copies: the archive.org English OCR, and the clean Charubel–Sepharial parallel edition (trans. R. Lidid, 2004, archive.org "Charubel"). Saturn's meaning has been recovered, and Pluto's degree has been corrected. Charubel 1 Charubel 2 Ascendant, Pisces 20-21: "A man walking in darkness with an old-fashioned lantern." Much individuality and much adversity, but he "will find his way out of every difficulty, ever guided by a divine instinct". What this means for you: you get through dark stretches on inner guidance, a light you carry yourself. Jupiter, Pisces 19-20: "An angel blowing a trumpet." "Denotes one whose office will be to publish to the world some important message… on the social or spiritual condition of mankind. A preacher, a lecturer, or some popular person." What this means for you: this is the strongest single symbol in the chart, because it sits on your rising planet. The tradition reads it as a voice that carries a message. Sun, Libra 20-21: "A cross formed of darts." "A very positive character… strong will… never allow anyone to impose on him… one with magical abilities." What this means for you: under the Libra courtesy is a will that cannot be pushed around. Moon, Leo 7-8: "A hedgehog." Harmless and secretive; shuns the public gaze; knows how to defend himself. What this means for you: despite the Leo Moon, your private self is guarded, and you show it only to a few. Mercury, Scorpio 2-3: "A triangle." A variety of gifts and force of character; "will make his mark in the world"; commands respect. What this means for you: your mind is versatile and leaves a lasting impression. Venus, Libra 16-17: "A horse saddled and bridled, without a rider." Charubel reads the horse as the senses and the rider as the mind. What this means for you: your gifts of pleasure and charm are ready to go. Put the mind in the saddle and they become power instead of drift. Mars, Virgo 3-4: "A square patch of ground, like a lawn-tennis court, covered with red cloth." "Born to enjoy good things… plenty follows him", with a warning against wilful waste. What this means for you: your effort brings in resources. Look after them. Saturn, Taurus 0-1: "A black, diamond-shaped figure." A strong, reserved character with strong will-power and magical powers, inclined to severity. What this means for you: your Saturn is a hard, dark stone of will. It is quiet, but it does not break. Uranus, Aquarius 8-9: "a farmer's horse and cart, a man driving." Content with his lot. The neighbouring degree, 7-8, shows "an astrological chart… fond of Astrology". What this means for you: your originality has a plain, practical side. Neptune, Capricorn 29-30: "A shepherd on the mountain top with crook." "Called to be a leader and a commander of a society, a community, or perchance a nation… pre-eminently the degree of rule." What this means for you: your ideals lean toward guiding a group. Pluto, Sagittarius 6-7: "A lady seated on a divan, fanning herself." "A fortunate degree; always denotes prosperity." (The earlier "precipice" reading came from the neighbouring degree because of a column split in the OCR. It has been corrected.) What this means for you: your soul ruler sits on a degree of ease and plenty. Deep change tends to leave you better off. North Node, Leo 28-29: mathematical instruments with a blank sheet. Mathematical ability beyond the ordinary. The next degree, 29-30, is the old sage at the midnight lamp, "a true magician". What this means for you: your growth path runs through exact, structured knowledge. MC, Sagittarius 25-26: "A giant of monstrous dimensions." "A prodigy of some kind; maybe in stature or maybe in mind." What this means for you: your public aim is to do something outsized. Synthesis, Charubel: the rising pair (lantern and trumpet) make one image: a man who finds his way through darkness and then announces what he found. The Sun's darts and the Moon's hedgehog guard that mission. Neptune's "degree of rule" and the MC "giant" give it scale.

Sepharial's Chaldean name-number for CHARLES LEONE works out as CHARLES 22 + LEONE 25 = 47, then 4 + 7 = 11, then 1 + 1 = 2. What this means for you: Sepharial reads 11 as a master number and 2 as the number of the Moon, of pairs and of balance. That echoes your Libra Sun. Hebrew values ( The Kabala of Numbers , p. 29). Sepharial's Hebraic unit table (1 = A, I, Y, Q, J; 2 = B, C, K, R; 3 = G, L, S; 4 = D, M, T; 5 = E, N; 6 = U, V, W, X; 7 = O, Z; 8 = F, P, H; 9 = Th, Tz) gives CHARLES 24 + LEONE 25 = 49, then 13, then 4 . In his scheme 4 is the Earth or the Sun. Using full Hebrew letter-values instead, which is the method behind his "Napoleone = 361", CHARLES = 561 (3, Jupiter) and LEONE = 160 (7, the Full Moon), giving a total of 721, then 10, then 1, the Sun . Hebrew values What this means for you: the Hebrew reckonings land on the Sun and on Jupiter, which is your rising planet. The name carries the same signature of solar self and expansive teaching that the chart does. Sepharial's La Volasfera (1898): your degrees A full 360-degree text of La Volasfera does exist. It is printed alongside Charubel in Lidid's parallel edition (archive.org "Charubel", 2004). The meanings below are my English renderings from that edition, abridged. Volasfera 1 Volasfera 2 Ascendant, Pisces 21: an ancient hieroglyphic manuscript with a retort and crucible. The Great Work: a mind given to reform that will found a new school of thought. What this means for you: your rising degree is about deciphering old wisdom and turning it into something new. Jupiter, Pisces 20: a helical scroll. A mind that turns over many ideas. What this means for you: your gift for ideas needs one fixed purpose to aim it. Sun, Libra 21: a broken bridge over a dry river-bed. What this means for you: plans may need a second crossing. Persistence repairs what breaks. Moon, Leo 8: an aureole of clouds with a flaming triangle and an eye. "Ardour", divine fire. What this means for you: your inner life is lit by spiritual feeling. Mercury, Scorpio 3: an old man meditating under a shady tree. What this means for you: you think like a pilgrim-philosopher. Venus, Libra 17: an old door with a dagger thrust into it. What this means for you: you are careful and discerning in love. Mars, Virgo 4: a cornfield ripe for harvest. What this means for you: your effort brings in a harvest. This agrees with Charubel's "plenty follows him". Saturn, Taurus 1: a pleasant-faced woman pointing a sword to the earth. Strength joined with diplomacy. What this means for you: you prevail through firmness that is kindly. Uranus, Aquarius 9: a great rock split by lightning. Convinces sceptics on celestial matters; lets light into dark places. What this means for you: your originality can break through closed minds. Neptune, Capricorn 30: an arrow in flight. What this means for you: your ideals aim high. Pluto, Sagittarius 7: a man with his foot on a spade, holding a jewel. "Luck", rising by discovery. What this means for you: you dig and you find. North Node, Leo 29: two golden circles knotted with a blue ribbon. "Union". What this means for you: your growth comes through joining with another. MC, Sagittarius 26: a hound's mask. Fidelity and dramatic power. What this means for you: you are publicly known for loyalty. Synthesis, Volasfera: the two degree systems agree on the axis: Charubel's lantern-and-trumpet and Sepharial's manuscript-and-new-school. Both describe the bearer of a recovered teaching.

Cycles Kali Yuga. Blavatsky dates the start of the Kali Yuga to 3102 BCE. Its first 5,000 years closed in 1897-98, which she and William Judge treated as a turning point. You were born in Kali year 5099, exactly one century after that mark. What this means for you: by Theosophical reckoning you belong to the first generation of the second century after the "5,000-year" close. That period was expected to bring a new spiritual impulse. Sixth sub-race. SD II 444: "the Americans… are the germs of the Sixth sub-race". What this means for you: by Blavatsky's map, being born in America places you in the soil she named for the next sub-race. The last-quarter-century law. The Key to Theosophy says that in the last quarter of every hundred years a new effort is made, and a "new torch-bearer of Truth" will come after 1975. You were born in 1998, inside that quarter. Naros The Naros (600 years; Isis Unveiled , "Secret Cycles"). Kali 5099 equals eight Naroi plus 299 years, which puts your birth at the exact midpoint of the ninth Naros (the midpoint, Kali 5100, falls in 1999). Counted from the 1897-98 close, you were born 100 years into a new Naros. What this means for you: you arrived at the balance-point of the cycle, which suits a Libra Sun. The Messianic cycle (about 2,155 years; "The Esoteric Character of the Gospels", Lucifer 1887). Blavatsky has the Piscean cycle close at the end of the nineteenth century, so you were born about a century into the Aquarian cycle. What this means for you: you belong to the first full generation of the new age. Synthesis, Blavatsky: your birth falls at three Theosophical landmarks: the century mark after Kali 5000, the American cradle of the sixth sub-race, and the 1975-2000 window.

Houses 1st house (Pisces→Aries). Jupiter is on the cusp. What this means for you: you come across as wise, kind and a natural teacher. 2nd house (Aries→Taurus). Saturn retrograde. What this means for you: money and values build slowly and solidly. This is the Bridge in Leo's sense. 3rd house (Taurus→Gemini). Empty. Its ruler, Venus, is strong. What this means for you: you speak and learn gracefully. 4th house (Gemini→Cancer). Empty. Its ruler, the Moon, is in the 5th. What this means for you: home is a place to be creative. 5th house (Cancer→Leo). The Moon. What this means for you: creativity, play and children are a central part of how you live. 6th house (Leo→Virgo). Mars and the North Node. What this means for you: you grow through skilled daily work and service. 7th house (Virgo→Libra). The Sun and Venus. What this means for you: partnership is where your Individuality comes alive. 8th house (Libra→Scorpio). Mercury. What this means for you: you think deeply about shared resources and hidden things. 9th house (Scorpio→Sagittarius). Pluto, the soul ruler. What this means for you: philosophy and travel transform you. 10th house (Sagittarius→Capricorn). The MC is at Sagittarius 25. What this means for you: your public aim is teaching or doing something big. 11th house (Capricorn→Aquarius). Neptune and Uranus. What this means for you: groups, ideals and humanity-wide causes matter to you. 12th house (Aquarius→Pisces). Jupiter in its own sign. What this means for you: you have hidden reserves of faith and grace. Aspects Major aspects (orb in degrees), the basis for the strengths below. What this means for you: the Moon's tight trine to Pluto and its opposition to Uranus are the chart's main engine.

Hidden strength 1 Hidden strength 2 Jupiter: strong. What this means for you: your main asset. Venus: strong. What this means for you: grace. Uranus: strong. What this means for you: original will. Pluto: strong. As soul ruler it has a 1.3° trine to the Moon. What this means for you: change comes smoothly. Saturn: strong-in-shadow. It is retrograde, but it trines Mars, the Node and the MC and is the hierarchical ruler of the Sun. What this means for you: a quiet backbone. Moon: strong-in-shadow. It is opposed by Uranus and squared by Saturn, but makes an exact trine to Pluto. What this means for you: pressure that strengthens you. Neptune: strong-in-shadow. It is at 29° Capricorn, Charubel's "degree of rule". What this means for you: its strength shows as ideals of leadership rather than in any obvious way. Sun: reversed-strong. The Sun is in its classical fall in Libra, but its dispositor Venus and its esoteric ruler Uranus are both in their own signs. What this means for you: the apparent weakness turns into strength through partners and through will. Mercury: reversed-strong. It is opposite Saturn, but in mutual reception with Mars. What this means for you: hard lessons sharpen the mind. Mars: weakness cancelled. It is cadent, but the mutual reception with Mercury cancels that weakness. What this means for you: effort pays off.

docs.h: 7a. Placidus houses, the planetary hour and Vulcan
docs.t: Placidus cusps Placidus planets Leo used Placidus houses, so these were computed directly (RAMC 264.56°, latitude 40.33°N). Two placements move. Mercury goes into the 7th (the 8th cusp is at Scorpio 4°20'). Saturn goes into the 1st (the 2nd cusp is at Taurus 4°20'). What this means for you: in Leo's own houses your mind works through partnership, and Saturn, "the Bridge", stands in the house of the self. Discipline becomes part of who you are, not just how you earn. Planetary hour Planetary hour. You were born on a Tuesday (the day of Mars), in the 11th planetary hour, which is the hour of Mercury . What this means for you: the hour ruler is Mercury, and your Mercury is in mutual reception with Mars, the day ruler. Leo reads that as action and thought working together. Vulcan (final finding). Bailey makes Vulcan the esoteric ruler of Taurus and says it is "veiled" by the Sun. It has no orbit and no ephemeris, so its position cannot be computed for any chart , including yours. It is handled here only symbolically, through the Sun and Taurus Saturn. What this means for you: the Vulcan theme of forging the soul is read through your Saturn in Taurus.

Ages 0-19 Ages 20-39 Ages 40-59 Ages 60-80 These use secondary progressions (a day for a year, from The Progressed Horoscope ), with the MC and Ascendant moved by solar arc, at a 1° orb. The years now under way: - 2027-2029: the progressed Sun trines Jupiter and then the Ascendant. The progressed Moon reaches the Node in 2027, and the solar-arc Ascendant opposes the Sun in 2027-28. What this means for you: this is the strongest stretch of the decade for opening up and being recognised, and it lands during your Saturn return (2028). - 2032-2033: the solar-arc MC conjoins Neptune. What this means for you: your vocation takes on an idealistic, leading direction (Neptune's "degree of rule"). - 2038-2039: the progressed Sun enters Sagittarius, and the solar-arc Ascendant meets Saturn. What this means for you: a new chapter of your life, centred on teaching and philosophy, begins on firm ground. - 2041-2043: the solar-arc MC conjoins Uranus, and the progressed Sun conjoins Pluto. What this means for you: original work becomes public, and a deep renewal follows.

Triangles All seven of Bailey's ray triangles were checked against your chart. Three are fully occupied : ray 4 (Taurus-Scorpio-Sagittarius: Saturn, Mercury, Pluto), ray 5 (Leo-Sagittarius-Aquarius: Moon, Pluto, Uranus, linked by the Moon-Pluto trine and the Moon-Uranus opposition), and ray 6 (Virgo-Sagittarius-Pisces: Mars, Pluto, Jupiter and the Ascendant). Rays 1, 2 and 3 have two of their three signs occupied. What this means for you: the full triangles point to harmony won through conflict (ray 4), concrete knowledge (ray 5) and devotion (ray 6), with Sagittarius-Pluto as the hub of all three. Festivals 2026-28 Festivals 2029-30 Bailey's three spring festivals are Easter (the Aries full moon), Wesak (Taurus) and Goodwill (Gemini). Their full moons for 2026-2030 were set against your chart: - First Taurus full moon, 20 Apr 2027, 18:27 EDT: on your Saturn (0.3°). 2027 has two Taurus full moons, and Lucis Trust's 2027 calendar keeps Wesak for the second one. What this means for you: the opening of the Wesak season lands on your Saturn, your "Bridge". This is the season's run-up, not the festival itself. - Wesak, 20 May 2027, 06:59 EDT: the Sun trines your Neptune (0.2°) and squares your Node (0.6°). What this means for you: the festival itself falls on your Neptune, your "degree of rule". Ideals and vision get the light, and the Node square asks you to choose which direction to follow. - Easter, 9 Apr 2028: the full moon falls on your Sun (0.2°). What this means for you: a Christ-festival full moon on your Individuality, in your Saturn-return year. - Wesak 2028: the full moon trines Jupiter and the Ascendant. Goodwill 2029: the Moon on Pluto (0.5°). Goodwill 2030: the Moon on your MC (0.3°). What this means for you: each spring from 2027 to 2030 a festival full moon lands on one of your main points: Saturn, the Sun, Jupiter, Pluto, then the MC.

docs.h: 7d. Charubel's degrees for the house cusps and the Part of Fortune
docs.t: Charubel cusps The Ascendant and MC were covered in §3. These are the other ten Placidus cusps, plus the Part of Fortune (ASC + Moon − Sun, day birth: Capricorn 7°50'). - 2nd, Tau 5: a boat on a lake, two men rowing. What this means for you: you earn through partnership and you like change. Keep speculation in proportion. - 3rd, Gem 3: a Corinthian column holding up buildings. What this means for you: your thinking and writing can carry a large structure. Charubel reads it as the founder or defender of a big scheme. - 4th (IC), Gem 26: a spacious room of costly furniture and mirrors. What this means for you: your home and roots are cultivated, social and artistic. - 5th, Can 17: an artificial globe. What this means for you: you take your pleasures in travel, study and discovery. - 6th, Leo 12: a ship under full sail on a calm sea. What this means for you: in daily work, "whatever he does shall prosper". It is the best of your cusp symbols. - 7th (DSC), Vir 21: an ostrich. What this means for you: a warning about show in partnership. Choose substance over display, in yourself and in the people you pick. - 8th, Sco 5: a clover (faith, hope, charity). What this means for you: shared resources go into schemes that benefit many. Charubel ties this degree to inventors. - 9th, Sag 3: a man at a drafting table. What this means for you: your philosophy is a matter of design. You are an architect of ideas. - 11th, Cap 17: a man weighing with large scales. What this means for you: among friends and in groups you are the one who measures fairly and gets the details right. - 12th, Aqu 12: a gravedigger. What this means for you: you keep a private, reserved side and bury what is finished. Give it space without letting it cool your warmth. - Part of Fortune, Cap 8: a dejected man on a barren plain under dark clouds. What this means for you: Charubel's tone here is sombre. Read gently, it says fortune does not come from luck or outward events. It comes from the inner work the rest of the chart describes, done steadily through quiet stretches.

docs.h: 7e. The seven principles and their planets (Blavatsky)
docs.t: Seven principles The source is Blavatsky's Esoteric Section Instruction No. I , Diagram II. It gives each human principle a planet, colour, metal and day: Kama-rupa = Mars, Prana = Sun, Buddhi = Mercury, Kama-Manas = Saturn, Auric Envelope = Jupiter, higher Manas = Venus, Linga-sarira = Moon. Atman is not counted as a principle. - Kama-rupa (Mars, Virgo, 6th). What this means for you: you put your desire into useful, exact work. You were born on a Tuesday, Mars's day, so this principle sets the tone of your birth. - Prana (Sun, Libra, 7th). What this means for you: you get your vitality through relationship and balance. - Buddhi (Mercury, Scorpio). What this means for you: your spiritual intuition works by going deep. You were born in a Mercury hour, which ties your birth moment to Buddhi. - Kama-Manas (Saturn, Taurus 0°, retrograde). What this means for you: your lower mind is slow, practical and set on the material. This is the "Bridge" that has to be crossed and refined. - Auric Envelope (Jupiter, Pisces, rising). What this means for you: with Jupiter on the Ascendant, your aura, the vessel of the whole, is wide and receptive. It is the first thing people meet in you. - Higher Manas (Venus, Libra, own sign). What this means for you: your higher mind is strong and works through beauty, harmony and justice. - Linga-sarira (Moon, Leo, 5th). What this means for you: your astral double is warm and expressive, the creative mould for your form. - Synthesis: Mars (birth day), Mercury (birth hour), Jupiter (rising) and Venus (in its own sign) are emphasised, so desire, intuition, aura and higher mind stand out. Saturn's Kama-Manas is where the work lies.

Sepharial lunations Sepharial's Manual of Astrology (Book III, ch. V, "Lunations", and the Supplement) gives three lunar methods. 1. Lunations. A new moon on the MC, Ascendant, Sun, Moon or a planet marks an event within the following month. It brings on a direction of the same nature within about fourteen days, often at the next full moon, and holds back one of opposite nature. Two or three successive new moons on key places mark an epoch. On benefics the result is good, on malefics testing, and eclipses strengthen the effect. 2. The Lunar Equivalent. Using birth-time arithmetic, 2 hours equal one month and 4 minutes one day, so the progressed Moon's aspects can be timed to the month. 3. The Diurnal Horoscope. This is a chart set for the birth time on any day. Transits over its angles time the day, and the house of the month's new moon shows which area of life the month's changes touch. From the 2026-2030 table: - New moon on Neptune, 18 Jan 2026. What this means for you: a month for setting ideals and plans. - Lunar eclipses on Mars, 28 Aug 2026 and 20 Feb 2027. What this means for you: two eclipses on your working planet (6th house) bring changes in your work, duties and methods. - New moons on Venus, 10 Oct 2026 and 7 Oct 2029, near your birthday. What this means for you: these are benefic lunations, good months for partnership, agreements and creative work. - New moon on Pluto, 27 Nov 2027. What this means for you: a month for discovery, Charubel's "jewel found by digging" on your Pluto degree. - New moon on the Node, 20 Aug 2028. What this means for you: a month that sets your direction, in the Saturn-return year. - New moon on the MC, 15 Dec 2028, then a lunar eclipse on the MC, 15 Jun 2030. What this means for you: career and public standing come into focus. The eclipse accentuates it, and Sepharial reads it as a turning point in reputation. - New moons on the Moon (30 Jul 2030), Mars (28 Aug 2030) and Mercury (26 Oct 2030). What this means for you: this is Sepharial's "epoch": successive new moons on key places. Late 2030 is a period of marked change in home, work and thought.

docs.h: 7g. The soul and personality rays: final finding
docs.t: Bailey says plainly that the soul ray and personality ray cannot be read from the horoscope alone. She treats them as matters of meditation, self-observation and the teacher's insight. The sign and planet ray qualities give this chart a ray "climate", with no verdict. The second ray comes through Jupiter in Pisces rising (Pisces carries rays 2 and 6). The third ray comes through the Libra Sun (Libra carries ray 3), with ray-1 Pluto as the esoteric ruler of the rising sign. What this means for you: treat "soul ray 2, personality ray 3" as a working hypothesis to test against your own experience. The chart suggests it but cannot prove it, and by Bailey's own rule the question stays open here.

The matches. Your chart carries the signatures that Theosophy gives its awaited figures: - The World Teacher's Pisces World-Saviour Ascendant, with ray-2 Jupiter rising on Charubel's trumpet-angel degree ("to publish to the world some important message"). - Sepharial's new school of thought on that same Ascendant. - Bailey's Christ signs: the Aquarian pitcher-bearer (Uranus, the esoteric ruler of your Sun) and the Libra "Spirit of Equilibrium" (your Sun and Venus). - The May Festival overshadowing of a first-ray disciple: ray-1 Pluto rules your Ascendant, and the Wesak season of 2027 opens with a full moon on your Saturn (20 Apr). Wesak itself, 20 May, trines your Neptune. - Kalki's white horse, centaur, fish and Virgo. - The Manu's American birth, first ray, and "degree of rule". - The 1975 torch-bearer's birth in the last quarter of the century, the trumpet, and Uranus as the lightning that splits the rock. Each figure's own chart follows, matches first. These are comparisons of symbols. They do not identify you with any figure. World Teacher World Teacher / Maitreya. In Besant and Leadbeater, Maitreya is head of the Second-Ray department. SD I 384 equates Maitreya with Kalki. - Match: a second-ray soul point, with ray-2 Jupiter rising in Pisces (rays 2 and 6). - Match: Pisces is Bailey's World-Saviour sign, and it is your Ascendant. - Match: Charubel's trumpet angel, "to publish to the world some important message", sits on your rising Jupiter. - Match: Sepharial's Ascendant degree, the hieroglyphic manuscript, "will found a new school of thought". - Match (symbolic): Venus, the planet of the Lords of Flame, is in her own sign and conjunct your Sun. - Not present: no Theosophical Society upbringing as a prepared vehicle. - Not present: SD I 470 places the true Saviour after the Kali Yuga. Christ Bailey, The Reappearance of the Christ (1948). - Match: the Aquarian age and "a man bearing a pitcher of water" (Luke 22:10). Your Uranus is in Aquarius in the 11th house and is the esoteric ruler of your Sun. - Match: a Pisces Ascendant with the soul keynote "turning back, I save". - Match: Libra, the hall of decision, holds your Sun and Venus. Bailey ( Reappearance , ch. 4) names the "Spirit of Equilibrium" as one of the Christ's overshadowing powers. Equilibrium is the Libra principle. - Match: the "Dispenser of the Water of Life", the Aquarian pitcher-bearer ( Reappearance , ch. 4). - Match: at the May (Wesak) Festival a first-ray disciple is overshadowed ( Externalisation of the Hierarchy ). Your Ascendant is ruled by ray-1 Pluto, Wesak itself (20 May 2027, per Lucis Trust) trines your Neptune, and the first Taurus full moon (20 Apr) falls on your natal Saturn. - Match: timing after 2025. What this means for you: you are pulled toward responsibility and authority. Líf and Lífþrasir (Vafþrúðnismál 45): "morning dews for food". - Pisces, the water sign, is rising. Symbolic match. What this means for you: you are fed by quiet, small sources and come through. 4.2 Celtic Arthur, rex quondam rexque futurus (Malory; Geoffrey, Historia and Vita Merlini ). - Arthur's Wain (Ursa Major) was up and high. Match. - Telyn Arthur (Lyra, Vega) was at the zenith, 78.6 degrees. Match. - The bear ( arth ): the Great Bear was up. Match. - The king: Jupiter, the regal planet, was rising. Match. What this means for you: the Arthurian sky stood fully over you, harp, wain, bear and king. Yours is a sky of leadership and loyalty. Charles's Wain. - His given name is the Wain's name in English (Charles's Wain) and Norse (Karlsvagn), and that figure was above the horizon at birth. Match. What this means for you: your name was literally overhead when you were born. Merlin, Prophetiae Merlini (Geoffrey, Historia VII): "Succedit leo iustitiae", "the lion of justice shall succeed". - The lion: his surname Leone means "lion", and his Moon is in Leo. Match. - Justice: his Sun and Venus are in Libra, the scales. Match. - The red dragon: red Mars stands 5.3 degrees from the Dragon's Head (mean node Leo 28.6). Match. What this means for you: you are a lion of justice in name and chart. You defend fairness boldly. Thomas the Rhymer ( The Whole Prophecie of Scotland , 1603; michaelriordan.co.uk/wholeprophesie). - Union of the crowns and of Britain under one king: Sun and Venus joined in the scales, the sign of union and balance. Symbolic match. - Thomas taken by the Queen of Elfland under the Eildon Hills: Venus in her own sign in the hidden 8th house, with the Sun, the Otherworld placement. Symbolic match. What this means for you: you bring sides together, and you have an Otherworld streak, a pull toward hidden knowledge and true speech. Aodh Eanghach, the expected deliverer (bardic prophecy; Wikipedia, "Aodh Eangach"; bardic.celt.dias.ie poem 185; applied to Red Hugh O'Donnell). - "Aodh" means fire; the epithet is read as "trail of fire". His names carry luis, "flame/lustre", twice. Match. - The red hero: ruis, "reddening of faces" and "glow of anger", sits in his first name. Match. - Fire: his Moon is in Leo, a fire sign. Symbolic match. What this means for you: you carry a fire-name and a fire-Moon. Like Aodh's, your strength is warmth that can become blazing resolve. Gearóid Iarla, who rides Lough Gur every seven years. - The seven-year return: his Saturn is retrograde at 0.9 Taurus, the start of a sign. Symbolic match. What this means for you: expect your life to move in seven-year turns. 4.3 Synthesis The chart matches the prophecies most strongly in three places. First, the Arthurian sky: harp at the zenith, the Wain high, a regal Jupiter rising, and a given name that is the name of the Wain. Second, Merlin's Lion of Justice: a Leo Moon, a Libra Sun and the surname Leone. Third, the Norse avenger and renewal figures: Váli's western birth at nightfall, Týr's day, Þórr's planet on the rising degree, the new earth lifting from the sea, and Völuspá 65's ruler from above. Thomas the Rhymer adds union and the Otherworld, and Aodh Eanghach adds the fire-name. 4.4 Markers with no counterpart in the chart Váli: the mother Rindr, unwashed hands, uncombed hair. Víðarr: the thick shoe, the silence, the land Viði. Baldr and Höðr: the blindness and the return from Hel. Inn ríki: the coming "to the great judgement". Líf and Lífþrasir: hidden in Hoddmímir's wood (only the modern Ivy fires). Arthur: Tintagel, Igerna and Uther, Avalon, the sword. Merlin: "Aper Cornubiae", the Boar of Cornwall. Armes Prydein Vawr (Book of Taliesin, NLW Peniarth MS 2, pp. 13–18, 199 lines, opening "Dygogan awen"): Cynan and Cadwaladr lead the Welsh, Irish, Dublin Norse, Cornish, Bretons and men of Strathclyde against the Saxons. No paired-leader or alliance marker (CODECS, "Armes Prydein"; maryjones.us/ctexts/t06.html). Thomas the Rhymer: the French wife bearing a son of Bruce blood; Haig of Bemersyde, "Tyde what may". Aodh Eanghach: the name Aodh/Hugh itself; driving out the foreigners; Cormac's vision. Owain Lawgoch and Owain Glyndŵr: the red hand, the cave. Gearóid Iarla: the silver horseshoes. Fionn and the Fianna: no literal marker.

Every historical northern system marks the same moment in you: the hinge. You fall at the end of the bright half of the Coligny month, at the end of harvest in the Irish year, on the first winter night of the Dalarna staves, in the last week of the Icelandic summer, and in the last light of the day. People of the hinge carry a cycle over into the next one. Your work tends to be closing, keeping and passing things on. Over that moment stood the Arthurian and Norse figures of rule and order. Arthur's Harp was at the zenith. The Wagon that bears your own name was high. The pole star was up, and Loki's torch was hidden. Your planets support the picture. Jupiter, the king and Þórr's planet, rises on your ASC and rules your MC. Mars, Týr's day-lord, is angular and in exchange with Mercury, which makes you oath-bound and articulate. Sun and Venus in the scales, with a lion Moon, reproduce Merlin's Lion of Justice in a man named Leone. The ogham kennings of your name add the rest: hazel of wisdom, lustre of the eye, the discerning tree, and nin's "establishing of peace". On the most probable Coligny count you were born on a good-marked day (MD) of Cutios, the month of invocations. Thomas the Rhymer's union and Aodh Eanghach's fire-name join the Arthurian and Merlin matches. Your character is a generous, judging, protective man who keeps his word and makes peace. You are strongest at turning points, and are tied to family and lineage. Your timing is late-phase: harvests come after the turn.
